Bloodfiend_10513.zh: 在这战败的王国中没有王子的一席之地。……因此他只能亲自登上王座，为王国指引方向。
Bloodfiend_10513.en: A defeated kingdom has no place for a Prince... Thus, he must rise to the occasion and crown himself its monarch.

Bloodfiend_10513.zh: 即使是在这座逼仄的宫殿中也能在每日晨间前来谒见。这份忠诚之心值得赞赏。希望你今后也能继续努力，与我们一同建设新的家族。
Bloodfiend_10513.en: Dedicating your mornings to be in the King's audience is, indeed, a most commendable demonstration of fealty. I shall trust in your continued support in this effort to build our new Family.

Bloodfiend_10513.zh: 正午……该是搭乘前往P公司列车的乘客登车的时间了。一旦他们抵达……想必会唤醒我血脉中那不可违抗的重压吧。这是成为了三代眷属的我所被赋予的，重建家族的重任。
Bloodfiend_10513.en:
Noon... passengers bound for P Corp. will be boarding soon. And when they do, this sanguine pressure, the responsibility to rebuild the Family will doubtless become unbearable.
The responsibility bestowed upon me... as the new Third Kindred.

Bloodfiend_10513.zh:
夜晚不会降临于这片王国。……但本能告诉我。此刻正是开始那场盛大游行的时间。
嘴角颤动……我，不得不……露出笑容。
Bloodfiend_10513.en:
Night does not descend upon this kingdom. But... I know by instinct that now is the hour of the Parade.
The corners of my lips are... twitching... I have to... smile.

Bloodfiend_10513.zh:
妈妈说，游行不能结束……
那么在这场尚未落幕的游行之中，我只需要……饰演好自己被分配到的角色即可。
Bloodfiend_10513.en:
Maman... has expressed that the Parade has no end...
All I have to do is... complete my role within this continuing procession.

Bloodfiend_10513.zh:
开始的一个月用餐要慢慢来。一天制造的血袋不要超过一只。让疲惫不堪的他们彼此内斗。
那之中最为优秀的人将成为我们的新家人。
Bloodfiend_10513.en:
Bridle your hunger for the first month; create no more than a single Bloodbag a day, and let the humans fight amongst themselves.
Only those who rise above the rest shall be permitted to join our Family.

Bloodfiend_10513.zh: 够了。维持这些数量即可。过多地制造会暴露这片王国。回到王国中沉睡吧。直到度过近乎永恒的时间，做好下一轮游行的准备为止……
Bloodfiend_10513.en: Enough. Create too many of us, and we risk the discovery of our furtive kingdom; thus, return and slumber. Sleep, until eons pass and the next procession is prepared...

Bloodfiend_10513.zh: 跪下并行礼吧。不必俯首。我想记住侍奉于我之人的面容。
Bloodfiend_10513.en: Kneel before me and display propriety. Do not lower your head, for I wish to remember the countenance of those in my service.

Bloodfiend_10513.zh:
昂首，阔步。将观众的表情变为笑容。
通过游行令他们领悟与王国共存是多么令人欣喜的事吧。
Bloodfiend_10513.en:
Raise your heads high, march forth with gusto, and make the crowd smile.
Let this procession demonstrate the elation of the joyful existence that awaits the kingdom's new subjects.

Bloodfiend_10513.zh: 不论是我与生俱来的角色，还是成为血魔后在游行中被赋予的职责，二者之间并无不同。我只是在回应期待而已。
Bloodfiend_10513.en: There are no meaningful differences between the role I was given at birth, and the role that was bestowed upon me as a Bloodfiend of the procession. I am only what is expected of me.

Bloodfiend_10513.zh: 游行开始。打开宫殿的门，让士兵们位于前列。在这永无止境的，充满祝福的嘉年华中……尽情享受吧。
Bloodfiend_10513.en:
The Parade commences. Open the palace gates and let the soldiers take the vanguard in this procession.
This is the endlessly, eternally blessed Carnival... So, do enjoy yourselves.

Bloodfiend_10513.zh: 是时候打开门了。
Bloodfiend_10513.en: Time to open the gates, is it?

Bloodfiend_10513.zh: 此为王之游行。
Bloodfiend_10513.en: Witness the King's march.

Bloodfiend_10513.zh: 用餐还愉快么？
Bloodfiend_10513.en: Are you enjoying the banquet?

Bloodfiend_10513.zh: 游行以及落幕。
Bloodfiend_10513.en: The Parade and its Finale.

Bloodfiend_10513.zh: 没错。俯首吧。
Bloodfiend_10513.en: That's it. Kneel.
... Hah. Blood... more blood...!

Bloodfiend_10513.zh: 你太弱了……无法加入家族。
Bloodfiend_10513.en: You... are too feeble to join the Family.

Bloodfiend_10513.zh: 最终……余之家族也同样步上了灭亡之路……
Bloodfiend_10513.en: Thus, in the end... our royal Family too, marches to ruin...

Bloodfiend_10513.zh: 如此一来，想必举办游行会更为轻松吧。
Bloodfiend_10513.en: With this, another obstacle to the Parade is removed.

Bloodfiend_10513.zh: 虽然不想再次品尝失败的滋味……但也要去忍受它。
Bloodfiend_10513.en: I've had my fill of failures, but... this too shall I endure.

Bloodfiend_10513.zh:
这次游行作为彩排而言还不错。
我的家族以及臣民们啊，命你们即刻准备下一轮游行。下次应当更加华丽吧。
Bloodfiend_10513.en:
That was an acceptable march for a dress rehearsal.
Heed me, O Family of mine and its royal subjects—prepare the new Parade, for what comes next shall be even greater.

Bloodfiend_10513.zh:
游行不能停止。直到越过这片狭窄、逼仄的王国，回到已然灭亡的那片土地为止。
看啊。他们昂首瞻仰我等身姿的那番光景……
Bloodfiend_10513.en:
Do not cease this procession, not until we rise beyond this narrow kingdom, not until we return to that land of our ruin.
Behold, as they gaze upon us in awe...

Bloodfiend_10513.zh: ……血还不够吗！哼……隐匿起来吧……只要再次从头开始就行。归根结底……一切都是一样的。
Bloodfiend_10513.en:
... Was that not enough blood...?! Nngh... Return to the shadows... we need only begin anew.
It's... all the same, anyway.

Cinq_10511.zh: 本次采访到此结束。详情请向西部Cinq协会宣传部门确认。
Cinq_10511.en: Today's interview ends here. Please refer any further questions to the Cinq Association West's Public Relations Department.

Cinq_10511.zh: 早上好。这原本是协会的晨练时间……详细采访需要较长时间，可以的话请在晨练后再来。
Cinq_10511.en: Good morning. This time of day is normally reserved for the Association’s morning workout sessions. As an interview may require a significant amount of time and undivided attention, I would like to request we table it until after the exercise has been completed.

Cinq_10511.zh: 您不需要用餐吗。关于课程教学计划的讨论已经进行了3小时14分钟，其他人都已经以用餐为由离开了……
Cinq_10511.en: Will you not join them for lunch? At the three-hour-and-fourteen-minute mark of our discussion regarding our curriculum, everyone else has left the interview for lunch, so...

Cinq_10511.zh: 晚上没有广播。虽然大多数观众对此有所要求，但我目前尚不明确直播个人私生活有何益处。
Cinq_10511.en: I do not broadcast at nighttime. Though a non-significant portion of my current viewership has requested such scheduling, it is difficult to yet determine what benefits could be gained from broadcasting one's private life.

Cinq_10511.zh:
您是问决斗直播吗。比起以个人宣传为目的，不如说是为了让众多匿名人士检查我在决斗中使用的剑术和姿势。
来自匿名人士的冷漠视线有助于客观化。
Cinq_10511.en:
You must be referring to live broadcasts of my duels. Their purpose has less to do with self-promotion, and more to do with allowing an anonymous group of evaluators to analyze my techniques and form.
The cold, uncaring gaze of the anonymous masses is beneficial to gaining an objective perspective of oneself.

Cinq_10511.zh: 虽然是西部协会，但Cinq的本质仍然相同。通过决斗，使对手屈膝投降，或是将其处理掉。仅此而已。
Cinq_10511.en: Every Cinq, regardless of its branch, is the same in its core. Defeat your foe via a duel and either bring them to their knees or execute them. Such is its simplicity.

Cinq_10511.zh:
因直播宣传而获得的委托确实占很大一部分，因此我不否认它的便捷。
据说南部会通过巡查来寻找后巷的雇主。……嗯，确实没有效率。
Cinq_10511.en:
The undeniable truth is that a significant portion of contracts are issued due to publicity garnered via live broadcasts, and that they offer a degree of convenience.
It has also been said that the southern branch often patrols the Backstreets to uncover new prospective clients. ... Mm. Such a method appears to be quite inefficient.

Cinq_10511.zh:
眼睛追不上我的动作很正常。这正是我训练的目的。
我推荐您观看直播回放，这样可以暂停画面分析我的动作和姿势。
Cinq_10511.en:
It is no surprise that my movements cannot easily be tracked by the naked eye. That was the precise purpose of the training, after all.
Revisiting previous broadcasts is recommended for those who wish to pause the feed in order to closely analyze the form.

Cinq_10511.zh:
经过了Öufi协会公证。确认过决斗对手是否同意。是以命相搏，还是仅为了一决胜负而决斗？
最终回应一经做出，将立即拿起剑。请充分思考。
Cinq_10511.en:
The Öufi Association has notarized this activity, and the opponent's agreement is in place. Will this duel be to the death, or merely determine the better swordsman?
It will commence once the reply is given. You may have as much time as you wish to think this over.

Cinq_10511.zh: ……啊，现在有时间了。应该可以进行剩余的采访。是从Cinq决斗教材第110页开始对吗？
Cinq_10511.en: ... Ah, this may be a good time to continue the interview. Shall we continue from page one-hundred-ten of the Cinq dueling manual?

Cinq_10511.zh: 请稍等。现在起我会进行决斗示范。采访请在那之后。
Cinq_10511.en: A moment, please. You will now observe a demonstration of a duel; the interview may resume afterward.

Cinq_10511.zh: 有委托吗。
Cinq_10511.en: A contract, then.

Cinq_10511.zh: 照例开始直播。
Cinq_10511.en: This will be broadcast as always.

Cinq_10511.zh: 我正在全神贯注。
Cinq_10511.en: Currently focused.

Cinq_10511.zh: Attaque（进攻）。
Cinq_10511.en: Attaque.

Cinq_10511.zh: 再来。决斗还没结束。
Cinq_10511.en: Again. This duel is not over.

Cinq_10511.zh: 嗯。Rompre（暂且中止）。
Cinq_10511.en: Hm. Rompre.

Cinq_10511.zh: 很好的决斗。
Cinq_10511.en: A good match.

Cinq_10511.zh: 还有……不足。回看……这次失败的录像……能学习……
Cinq_10511.en: So that... wasn't enough... Perhaps this defeat could be... reviewed... in a video...

Cinq_10511.zh: 观众们。面对该类情况可以这样解决。
Cinq_10511.en: This is how to handle one such situation, viewers.

Cinq_10511.zh: 有知道如何解决这种情况的观众吗……
Cinq_10511.en: Is there anyone among my viewers who knows the answer...?

Cinq_10511.zh: 一如既往的情况。短暂的危机，结果仍是胜利。可供观赏的部分比较少，对匿名观众来说多少有些遗憾。
Cinq_10511.en: There was nothing out of the ordinary in terms of today's schedule. A momentary crisis followed by a conclusive victory. It is unfortunate that the anonymous masses will not have much material to chew on.

Cinq_10511.zh: 压倒性胜利。我的剑术比以往更上了一层楼。观众应该会大幅增加。
Cinq_10511.en: An overwhelming victory. I believe that my skills with the blade have grown much since my previous attempt. This will surely result in increased viewership.

Cinq_10511.zh: 此次失败出乎预料。但仍然可以通过观看录像来复习失败原因，所以不算坏事。
Cinq_10511.en: Such defeat was not an expected outcome. However, as the reason for this defeat may be reviewed and analyzed, it can be said that this skirmish has yielded a net positive result.

DeadRabbit_10509.zh:
雨淅淅沥沥下个不停……
我没想到会有人在这种日子来访。你是什么沾满酒气的狗吗？
DeadRabbit_10509.en:
... I was not expecting any guests on such a drizzling day. 
What are you, a hound drenched in alcohol?

DeadRabbit_10509.zh: 太阳升起。今日你们也要前往各自负责的街区。管理应管之事，携带应携之物。
DeadRabbit_10509.en: The sun has risen. Work your respective streets. Manage what needs managing, take what's there to take.

DeadRabbit_10509.zh: 午饭……是啊。就去今天预定征收保护费的那家酒馆吧。若双方协商后从预定的保护费中提出一部分抵消餐费，对彼此都有利。
DeadRabbit_10509.en: For lunch... yes. We will head to the pub that owes us protection fee. It will be for the benefit of us all if we give them a discount on the protection fee equal to the amount of food we consume there.

DeadRabbit_10509.zh: 夜晚的街道是适合交战的环境。准备好战斗。我们要处理那些蚕食我们地盘的家伙。
DeadRabbit_10509.en: Streets during the night are ripe for conflict. Prepare for battle; we will clear the streets of those who leech on our territory.

DeadRabbit_10509.zh:
不知从何时起……有流言传说我们死兔帮与其他的黑帮不同，更为温和。我无法理解。
是指收取保护费后确实会进行保护的黑帮较为罕见吗。若能于不见血的情况下获取更多持续收益，这不是合理行动吗。
DeadRabbit_10509.en:
Word on the street is that... us Dead Rabbits are 'kind' for a gang. I fail to understand this perspective.
They say that not many gangs actually protect those they extort protection money from. Odd. I merely see this as a wise business decision to protect our future assets without unnecessary bloodshed.

DeadRabbit_10509.zh:
最近有个新人想要加入我们帮派。他身上没有水沟的臭味，约莫来自某个与帮派无缘的地方。
……他的眼中满含恶毒。我会试探他，如果有所用处就把他带走。
DeadRabbit_10509.en:
A new recruit joined our ranks. He did not smell like the gutters, so I do not understand what someone who hasn't spent much time in the streets is doing out here.
But his eyes... I saw venom in his eyes. I intend to let him stay with us as long as he is useful.

DeadRabbit_10509.zh: 在战斗开始前投掷围巾是我们死兔帮长久以来的传统。系成兔耳形状的围巾代表着向敌人跃去的场景。
DeadRabbit_10509.en: It is an old tradition of the Dead Rabbits to throw our scarves before a fight. This scarf, tied like a rabbit's ears, symbolizes our zeal as we hop our way into battle.

DeadRabbit_10509.zh:
时间……过去很久了。此时若与其他帮派冲突将有利可图。
比起消耗提供保护费的人的时间，从剥夺无数时间的其他帮派手上一次性吸收过来才更有效率。
DeadRabbit_10509.en:
A lot of... time has passed. A conflict with a different gang will be a benefit to our organization.
It is more efficient to take the time of those who have been extorting times of others for a long while than it is to collect protection fees.

DeadRabbit_10509.zh:
你问……希斯克利夫？他的战斗很不错。若非要说我的感受，那应该是他急于证明自身的存在价值而过分莽撞。
……我认为我们相处的时间会比预想中更久。
DeadRabbit_10509.en:
Heathcliff... was it? Not bad. I did notice that he may be overcompensating for something, however. It was as though he wanted to prove that his existence was worth it.
... I suppose I will be seeing him for longer than I expected.

DeadRabbit_10509.zh: 慢慢来。毕竟时间……总是能赚到的。
DeadRabbit_10509.en: Always take things slow. Time... can always be made again.

DeadRabbit_10509.zh: 快到补充时间的时候了。似乎有些不清楚自身斤两，在后巷闲逛的黑帮。是时候赚取时间了。
DeadRabbit_10509.en: We will soon have to make time. Quite opportune that there are other gangs roaming our streets. I see this as a perfect opportunity to make some extra time.

DeadRabbit_10509.zh: 到了去赚取时间的时候了。
DeadRabbit_10509.en: Time to make some... time.

DeadRabbit_10509.zh: 到死兔帮的时间了。
DeadRabbit_10509.en: It's the Dead Rabbits' time.

DeadRabbit_10509.zh: 目前时间并不多。
DeadRabbit_10509.en: I do not have much time at this moment.

DeadRabbit_10509.zh: 痛揍他们。
DeadRabbit_10509.en: I will thrash them.

DeadRabbit_10509.zh: 脑震荡了吗。都能看到兔子了吧。
DeadRabbit_10509.en: Are you hallucinating rabbits? You must be concussed.
Hm...

DeadRabbit_10509.zh: 我会带走你不再需要的时间。
DeadRabbit_10509.en: I will take what surplus time you have.

DeadRabbit_10509.zh: 我知道……这一天终会到来……直到最后……我都会慢慢地……
DeadRabbit_10509.en: I knew... that this day would come... I will take it slow... to my last breath...

DeadRabbit_10509.zh: 仅为时间问题。
DeadRabbit_10509.en: It was but a matter of time.

DeadRabbit_10509.zh: 我来负责。
DeadRabbit_10509.en: I will take responsibility for this.

DeadRabbit_10509.zh: 我们得到的时间比预想中要少，但我们通过这次争斗吸收了对方势力。影响力也会扩大一些吧。
DeadRabbit_10509.en: Though we haven't bought much time from this conflict, we have successfully absorbed their forces into our fold. Our sphere of influence grows.

DeadRabbit_10509.zh: 嗯……不错的战斗。新人也让我很满意。今后我也会积极接纳闯来的那些家伙们。
DeadRabbit_10509.en: Hm... well fought. I quite like our new recruit as well. I suppose we can start accepting more applicants that come our way.

DeadRabbit_10509.zh: 时间并不只是赚取而来。偶尔也会被夺走。……没关系。只要时钟内的时间没被全部夺走就没问题。
DeadRabbit_10509.en: Sometimes we end up losing time. ... This is fine. As long as there is some time remaining in our watch... we will be all right.

Dieci_10510.zh: 嗯，这次的晚自习没有人缺勤。重新积累挥发掉的知识固然可取，但也不要忘记学习新的知识。
Dieci_10510.en:
Mm, good. No one is absent from tonight's late-night studies session.
Remember not only to refill what you have burned but also to add new knowledge into your repositories.

Dieci_10510.zh:
早上了。不要拖拖拉拉，睁开眼睛后稍稍活动一下身体。
如果头脑和身体完全清醒，最好到外面去晒晒太阳，接着便去求知吧。
Dieci_10510.en:
It is morning. Do not linger in bed; open your eyes, move your body, and stir awake.
Once you are awake in both body and mind, go outside and take in the light. It is best that you begin your studies after the aforementioned routine.

Dieci_10510.zh:
已经是午饭时间了。此时吃得太饱的话会引起睡意。
一定程度的空腹感能提高集中力。如果你有之后的日程安排，最好记住。
Dieci_10510.en:
Already lunchtime, is it? Remember: overfeeding oneself is likely to invite sleep at too early an hour.
A certain level of hunger enhances focus. Keep that in mind if you have any endeavors scheduled later today.

Dieci_10510.zh: 马上就到孩子们的就寝时间了。睡眠是大脑处理和回顾清醒时收集到的知识的重要学习行为，建议保持安静，不要打扰他们。
Dieci_10510.en: The children must sleep soon. It is recommended that we maintain a degree of silence, for 'sleep' is an important part of the educational regimen in which the brain processes and reviews the knowledge that was gathered during the waking hours.

Dieci_10510.zh: 视线再凑近些。和钥派们不同，我们是以拳探寻，进而握取知识之人。
Dieci_10510.en: Hold your gaze closer. We are not like the Keys; we are those who claim our knowledge through contact with our fists.

Dieci_10510.zh:
除了하나协会的收尾人考核以外，Dieci协会内另外进行的知识考试也为求知提供了可持续的动机。
通过考试积累知识，总有一天会谒见圣者大人。
Dieci_10510.en:
Dieci Association's Knowledge Exams are additional, constant motivators separate from the exams conducted by the Hana Association.
Grow your knowledge. Use exams to motivate and push yourselves further. Only then shall you one day be permitted an audience with the Saints.

Dieci_10510.zh:
据记载，南部Dieci协会要用生命守护的圣物，是在很深的废墟中发现的。
在北部，东部及西方本部所守护的圣物也是如此。
Dieci_10510.en:
Records say that the Holy Relic, which we must protect with our lives, was discovered in the abyssal depths of the Ruins.
It is likely that the Holy Relics in the North, the East, or our headquarters in the West are also from the Ruins.

Dieci_10510.zh:
是问关于知识挥发后转换成强大的物理力量的现象吗……
嗯，关于此，现在的我并不知道，也许在这之前我曾知道，但也只是不明知而已。
Dieci_10510.en:
I see. You are inquiring me about the phenomenon through which the burning of knowledge directly translates to powerful physical force.
Mm, I am well-aware that I am unaware of its exact mechanisms. Perhaps my past self held knowledge that may be an answer to your query, but I am also unaware of the veracity of that statement.

Dieci_10510.zh:
积累知识等于积累生存的养分。这是被收养者的天性和规律，不能怠于积累新的知识。
这也是我常常对不喜欢求知的孩子们说的话。
Dieci_10510.en:
To gather knowledge is equivalent to scrounging nutrients for survival. Do not idle before erudition, for to scrounge is the nature and the rule of the adopted.
I have told as such to the children who have refused to study.

Dieci_10510.zh: 忘了来这里的理由了吗？如果忘记了，就应该重新求知。
Dieci_10510.en: Have you forgotten why you have come here? Then learn it again.

Dieci_10510.zh: 以缠绕于拳上的这片光辉之布释放层层积累的知识，将你碾碎。
Dieci_10510.en: Thus from this brilliant fabric radiates the weight of layers upon layers of knowledge; now, my fists wreathed in its full weight, shall smite you down.

Dieci_10510.zh: 以拳触碰求知的瞬间。
Dieci_10510.en: Let my fist be the conduit through which I attain knowledge.

Dieci_10510.zh: 只是按照Dieci的教义行事罢了。
Dieci_10510.en: I merely do as the doctrine of the Dieci dictates.

Dieci_10510.zh: 提问将在任务完成后被接受。
Dieci_10510.en: Questions must wait until this task is completed.

Dieci_10510.zh: 这也将成为知识。
Dieci_10510.en: Let this become knowledge as well.

Dieci_10510.zh: 因为知识不会永存。
Dieci_10510.en: To know is not eternal.
Mm...

Dieci_10510.zh: ……不要逃避无知。
Dieci_10510.en: ... Thus, turn not from ignorance.

Dieci_10510.zh: 我也迎来了……最理所当然的时刻吗……
Dieci_10510.en: The moment of inevitability claims me... as well...

Dieci_10510.zh: 这次做出了正确的选择。但不知下次是否还会正确。
Dieci_10510.en: This was a correct choice. However, this has no bearing on the accuracy of my subsequent choices.

Dieci_10510.zh: 也许这是已经被遗忘的知识。错误是理所当然的结果。
Dieci_10510.en: Perhaps the knowledge was already lost. This outcome was inevitable.

Dieci_10510.zh: 先想想遗忘了什么知识。胜利的喜悦在那之后尽情享受也为时不晚。
Dieci_10510.en: I must review what knowledge I have lost in this battle. Celebration can wait.

Dieci_10510.zh: 我仅仅是研习战斗中遗忘的东西与学到的东西，重新积累知识来完成Dieci协会的工作而已。
Dieci_10510.en: I merely review all that I have learned and forgotten from this battle. Once ready, I will continue to complete the Dieci Association's tasks.

Dieci_10510.zh: 虽然失败了，但是也能从中获得知识吧。所以接下来要做的，就是通过那些知识取得胜利。
Dieci_10510.en: We will gain new knowledge as a consequence of this defeat. Hone it to forge our next victory.

Kcorp_10505.zh: 唔……要办理新业务请往左侧……啊，是在叫我啊。
Kcorp_10505.en: Hm… You can place new assignments on the left— Ah, you called for me.

Kcorp_10505.zh: ……早上，了？奇怪。我好像还没打卡下班。
Kcorp_10505.en: …Is it… morning? C’est étrange. I do not remember clocking out.

Kcorp_10505.zh: 请让我……稍微休息一下。请您……先去吃午饭吧……
Kcorp_10505.en: Allow me… to nap for a moment. You can… have your lunch first…

Kcorp_10505.zh: 晚上通常都是外勤。啊，我刚刚休息过了，所以没有问题。
Kcorp_10505.en: My evenings are mostly occupied with outdoor assignments. Ah, I had my rest earlier today, so it’s fine.

Kcorp_10505.zh: 您所说的事情已经处理完毕。由于目前仍有四件工作亟待解决，新的请求在之后……可以处理。
Kcorp_10505.en: I have taken care of the task you told me. I currently have assignments from four people, so if you have another request to make… It will have to wait until I’m done with these.

Kcorp_10505.zh: 下班……已经有一段时间没有下过班了。但是因为被委托的工作仍未处理完，所以无可奈何。
Kcorp_10505.en: It has… been quite some time since I clocked out last. However, I cannot leave while the work I’ve been entrusted with isn’t done.

Kcorp_10505.zh: 您问……这饮品吗？不，我并不喜欢。但只有这个能在短时间内缓解疲劳。
Kcorp_10505.en: You’re… curious about this drink, I see. No, it’s not my preference. It simply is the only method I have to relieve exhaustion quickly.

Kcorp_10505.zh:
您是……要帮我处理工作吗？
难以理解。这是委任给我的工作。并没有分担的必要。
Kcorp_10505.en:
You’ll… do some of my work for me?
I do not understand. These assignments are my responsibility. There is no need to share my burden.

Kcorp_10505.zh: 最开始工作量并没有这么多。只是其他人将工作交付给我，而我代为处理，仅此而已。
Kcorp_10505.en: The workload wasn’t always this heavy. When others left their work to me, I simply proved capable of handling it.

Kcorp_10505.zh: ……（轻微的鼾声）
Kcorp_10505.en:
……
(He’s snoring softly)

Kcorp_10505.zh: 嗯。要加薪吗。我明白了。那么我必须得去完成剩余的工作……
Kcorp_10505.en: Hm. You’re giving me a raise. Entendu. Pardon me then, as I have tasks to take care of…

Kcorp_10505.zh: 您需要我对吧。
Kcorp_10505.en: I see you need me.

Kcorp_10505.zh: 开始外勤工作。
Kcorp_10505.en: Engaging in external assignment.

Kcorp_10505.zh: 有什么要求吗？
Kcorp_10505.en: I presume you have a request.

Kcorp_10505.zh: 就这样做吧。
Kcorp_10505.en: Entendu, will do.

Kcorp_10505.zh: 能看到工作逐渐完成。
Kcorp_10505.en: The assignment is steadily approaching completion.

Kcorp_10505.zh: 啊。
Kcorp_10505.en: Gasp.

Kcorp_10505.zh: 解决了一个。
Kcorp_10505.en: One has been taken care of.

Kcorp_10505.zh: 啊……稍微……休息一下……
Kcorp_10505.en: Ah… Allow me… to rest for a moment…

Kcorp_10505.zh: 似乎能……准时下班。
Kcorp_10505.en: It appears I… will be able to leave work on time.

Kcorp_10505.zh: 看来我已经确定……要加班了。
Kcorp_10505.en: That has confirmed that I… will have overtime.

Kcorp_10505.zh: 工作完成。我将返回事务所。
Kcorp_10505.en: Assignment complete. I’ll be returning to the office.

Kcorp_10505.zh: 工作完成。……我能直接回家吗。我明白了。呼……
Kcorp_10505.en: Assignment complete. …You mean that I can go home today. Entendu. Ouf…

Kcorp_10505.zh: 事情……变得复杂起来了。
Kcorp_10505.en: Things… have gotten complicated.

LCB_10501.zh: 默尔索。请如此称呼我吧，经理。
LCB_10501.en: Meursault. Please refer to me as such, Manager.

LCB_10501.zh: 社规里明确表示员工应在规定时间起床。看来包括您在内的大多数罪人并不知道此事。
LCB_10501.en: The company rules say that its employees are to get up at designated hours. It appears most Sinners are unaware of this fact, and so are you.

LCB_10501.zh: 如果您问我如何度过午后时光……没有规定表明该做什么。
LCB_10501.en: If you ask me how I intend to spend my afternoon… No rules state what to do.

LCB_10501.zh: 如果一定要我比较，我在一天中喜欢白天胜过黑夜。黑暗遮掩视野，难视之物难解。
LCB_10501.en: If I had to compare the times of day against each other, I prefer day to night. Darkness obscures vision, and what is hard to see is hard to understand.

LCB_10501.zh: 有什么需要我做的吗，经理？如有特殊原因，请指明。
LCB_10501.en: Do you have any business with me, Manager? If there is a particular reason, do make it clear.

LCB_10501.zh: 人们建议我平日里多笑笑。您也如此希望吗，经理？
LCB_10501.en: People suggest that I smile more often. Do you want that as well, Manager?

LCB_10501.zh: ……您频繁向我搭话。是执行经理的规定指示您如此的吗？
LCB_10501.en: …You continue to speak with me. Are you encouraged by the rules to do so?
I shall wait here until you return.
Yes, if that is what you want.
If the rules say so.
Is there a problem, Manager?

LCB_10501.zh: 我会根据规定执行命令。
LCB_10501.en: I shall execute the order according to the rules.
I am awaiting your next order.
Ugh!
Done accordingly.
Please take care of this by the rules.
I made it.
I failed.
I simply followed orders.
It’s what should have been done; compliments are redundant.
I implore you to revise the strategy.

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 若您需要火焰，我会为您点燃。
LiuAsso6_10502.en: If it is fire you need, then I will provide it.

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 时间一到我便会自然而然地睁开双眼。不必惊讶我起得多早。
LiuAsso6_10502.en: My eyes opened because it was time to wake up. There is no need to be amazed by how early I rise.

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 空余时间我会帮助其他人训练。最开始的时候我只指导一个人，之后却在不知不觉中成为了一项日常惯例。
LiuAsso6_10502.en: In my spare time, I help others with their training. I only did it for one person at first, but as time went on, it became a regular routine.

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 如果您讨厌黑暗我可以为您照亮四周。我的火焰是6科中最为明亮的。
LiuAsso6_10502.en: I can brighten your surroundings if you dislike the dark. My fire is the brightest in Section 6.

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 如果事情进展不顺……您首先应该仔细检查问题所在。
LiuAsso6_10502.en: If things are not going well… you start by carefully examining the problem.

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 别人经常认为我不常说话是因为性格沉闷。这并非负面因素，所以我也不会致力于改正这点。
LiuAsso6_10502.en: Others often assess my infrequency of speech as stifling. As it is not a negative factor, I do not make an active effort to rectify it.

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 正如时机到来，我与经理便会相遇……因此只要时机到来，我们便能寻得金枝。
LiuAsso6_10502.en: I arrived here and met you because it was time… Similarly, we will find the Golden Bough when the right time comes.

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 从至今为止的管理经验来看，以经理您的能力应该可以轻易制造火焰。如果您希望如此……
LiuAsso6_10502.en: Judging from the managerial experience so far, someone of your caliber should be able to create a flame with ease. If you want…

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 无须执着于失忆一事。对经理您而言，记忆复原之日自然会到来。
LiuAsso6_10502.en: Don’t let your loss of memory distract you too much. I am certain the moment of recovery will come naturally.

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 如果您有紧急事务，可以离开。
LiuAsso6_10502.en: You may leave me if you’re urgently needed.

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 我会努力燃起更为热烈的火焰。
LiuAsso6_10502.en: I will strive to become a keener flame.

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 若您需要火焰。
LiuAsso6_10502.en: If it’s a fire you wish for.

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 若您需要我的火焰。
LiuAsso6_10502.en: If you need this fire of mine.

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 进展不顺吗？
LiuAsso6_10502.en: Is it not progressing well?

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 请跟随我的火焰。
LiuAsso6_10502.en: Follow my fire.

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 进展顺利。
LiuAsso6_10502.en: It seems to have gone well.

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 呃！
LiuAsso6_10502.en: Nkh!

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 自然而然的结果。
LiuAsso6_10502.en: A natural outcome.

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 如果火焰能更猛烈一些……
LiuAsso6_10502.en: If only the fire were more intense…

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 我按需求照亮了道路。
LiuAsso6_10502.en: I lit the path as required.

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 火焰也会被风吹灭。
LiuAsso6_10502.en: Fires are susceptible to sudden gusts.

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 我能清楚地看见最适合击中的位置。
LiuAsso6_10502.en: I was able to see where to strike.

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 是的，我很喜欢这次引燃的火焰。
LiuAsso6_10502.en: Yes, I was fond of the fire I managed to ignite now.

LiuAsso6_10502.zh: 没关系。我已找到问题所在。
LiuAsso6_10502.en: It’s alright. I’ve grasped the problem.

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: 我是默尔索。负责辅佐幼兄。以上。
MiddleFinger_10507.en:
I am Meursault. I aid the Big Brother in his endeavors.
That is all.

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: 您醒了？请和我一起去客厅。其他兄弟姐妹们希望和您说话。
MiddleFinger_10507.en: Good morning. Let us head to the living room together. My fellow junior Brothers, senior Brothers, and Sisters want to have a chat with you.

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: 如果没有外出活动的安排，那就和留守的家人们一同进餐。一同聊天和用餐，是中指重要的日常。
MiddleFinger_10507.en: If you have no particular outdoor activities scheduled, then join the other remaining family for a meal. It is important that the Middle always dine and chat together.

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: 我……被大哥传唤，必须前往营业场所。不能缺席大哥的酒会。这是规矩。
MiddleFinger_10507.en: I... have been summoned by a senior Brother and must visit our site of business. I can not 'flake' on a drinking night with my senior Brothers. That is the rule.

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: 我们小辈之间没有辈分之分。那并不重要。在辅佐大哥的同时彼此互相帮助。仅此而已。
MiddleFinger_10507.en: Us junior Brothers do not concern ourselves with seniority amongst ourselves. It is a detail of very little significance. All we wish to do is to support each other and our senior Brothers, and no more.

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: 家族中的小小失误而已。前去处理这些失误，使我愉快些许。我学到这就是所谓忠义。
MiddleFinger_10507.en: Little mistakes may occur within a family. It is my little joy to sweep such little mistakes under the rug. I have been taught that that is true loyalty.

MiddleFinger_10507.zh:
这锁链寓意着纽带与连结。我们，皆被同一条锁链联系，共享命运，共同背负，共担责任。
没有取下锁链的必要，我们无法卸下，也不会尝试卸下它。
MiddleFinger_10507.en:
These chains represent solidarity and connection. Together, we who are bound by the same chain bear the responsibilities hand in hand. We will face our destinies and share the weight together.
We have no need to remove these chains. We have no means to remove these chains. And we have no need for those who intend to remove these chains.

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: 复仇账簿中记着许多事。从同伴死亡时的复仇方式……到走路时被踩了一脚的报复。本次施行的是……第3条，第1项……
MiddleFinger_10507.en: Many things are written in The Book of Vengeance. From instructions for avenging a Brother's death to instructions for avenging getting our foot stepped on in the streets. This time, I will refer to Title 3, Section 1...

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: 中指必将如数奉还。如果不是我们的人，那么任何情况都不算小事。
MiddleFinger_10507.en: The Middle always pays their debts. There are no 'little mistakes', unless the mistake is from one of us.

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: 我不习惯……独自一人。
MiddleFinger_10507.en: I am not used to... being on my lonesome.

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: 出了什么事吗？还请来详细说明。我会记述在账簿里，必将如数奉还。
MiddleFinger_10507.en: Has something happened to you? Please, come here and tell me what transpired, in full detail. I will add it to the Book of Vengeance so that this offense may be avenged.

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: 为了大哥大姐。
MiddleFinger_10507.en: For my senior Brothers and Sisters.

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: 进行热身。
MiddleFinger_10507.en: I will conduct a warm-up exercise.

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: 我在翻阅账簿。
MiddleFinger_10507.en: I am reading the Book.

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: 如数奉还。
MiddleFinger_10507.en: Vengeance comes for you.

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: 凭借这点决心就敢对我的家人出手吗。
MiddleFinger_10507.en: You should have prepared for retribution when you slighted a member of our family.

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: 呃。
MiddleFinger_10507.en: Kgh.

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: 悉数奉还了。
MiddleFinger_10507.en: Vengeance has been executed.

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: 不止……我……一个人……中指会铭记……
MiddleFinger_10507.en: I won't... Be the last... of us... The Middle... Remembers...

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: 嗯，可行。
MiddleFinger_10507.en: Hm. I have done it.

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: ……会有比我更合适的家人来接手的。
MiddleFinger_10507.en: ... A family member better suited for this job will take over.

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: 处理完毕。可以在账簿上划去一道了。
MiddleFinger_10507.en: This has been taken care of. We can cross that out from the Book of Vengeance.

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: 正如复仇账簿所写，尽数奉还了。这就是对家人出手的代价。谨记于心。
MiddleFinger_10507.en: Conditions as written on the Book of Vengeance have been fulfilled. This is what happens when one lays their hands upon a member of our family. Do not forget that.

MiddleFinger_10507.zh: 没关系。我会将他们的暴行记录进账簿……中指时刻铭记。家人们会来打抱不平的。
MiddleFinger_10507.en: It is all right. Their crimes are now written in the Book of Vengeance... The Middle remembers. The family will now come to claim their vengeance.

Ncorp_10504.zh: 执柄者之锤在此。
Ncorp_10504.en: Here is the hammer of the One Who Grips.

Ncorp_10504.zh: 到了锤炼躯体的时间。我建议您也参与进来，这有助于净化心灵。
Ncorp_10504.en: The time is ripe to discipline the body. I suggest that you participate in the gathering as well to help cleanse your mind.

Ncorp_10504.zh: 没想到会在此时遇见您。如果在工作中遇到任何困难，请不必迟疑，随时告诉我。
Ncorp_10504.en: I did not anticipate encountering you at this hour. If you have any woes regarding your work, please don’t hesitate to inform me.

Ncorp_10504.zh: 我建议您尽早就寝来保证健康。至于我……还有一些事项等待我去处理。
Ncorp_10504.en: I suggest you retire to bed early so that you may preserve your strength. As for myself… there is a matter that needs me to be gripped.

Ncorp_10504.zh: 随侍执柄者左右是本人至高无上的荣誉。我仍记得我被任命的那一刻。
Ncorp_10504.en: It is one’s highest honor to aid the One Who Grips. I still have not forgotten the moment I was appointed as such.

Ncorp_10504.zh: 您似乎对这根钉很好奇。这是用于制造N公司的经验罐头的。至于它的详细使用方法……您可以亲眼见证。
Ncorp_10504.en: So you are curious about this nail. This one is used to manufacture N Corp’s canned experiences. As for its use… You would do well to see where it’s used yourself.

Ncorp_10504.zh: 这副面具是执柄者赐予我的。因为我之前的面具无法隐藏生命维持液的管子。
Ncorp_10504.en: This mask has been bestowed upon me by the One Who Grips. The one I wore in the past could no longer conceal the tubes carrying lifefluid.

Ncorp_10504.zh: ……近期执柄者似乎正对某个具有成为“钉”资质的人保持关注。我想知道您是如何决定人选的。不知可否分享您的智慧。
Ncorp_10504.en: …It seems that there is someone recently holding the attention of the One Who Grips. It involves something about the potential to serve as a Nail. I would like to know how you determine who to appoint. Please share your wisdom.

Ncorp_10504.zh: 我是仅为那一根钉挥舞的锤。尽管执柄者坚持要我教授作为钉的候选者的人……不，如果这是执柄者的意愿，那么我会遵从。
Ncorp_10504.en: I am but a Hammer, serving a single Nail. Although the One Who Grips insists that I teach that disciple, a seed with the bearings of a Nail… Nay. If the One Who Grips instructs, then I am to follow.

Ncorp_10504.zh: 锤随时待命于此，静候被紧握之时。
Ncorp_10504.en: The hammer always waits in place, ready to be gripped.

Ncorp_10504.zh: 虽然微薄之力尚难以得到认可，但若您坚持如此，我会接受。
Ncorp_10504.en: Though I believe myself to be ever too puny to deserve such recognition, I will accept if you insist.

Ncorp_10504.zh: 我在。
Ncorp_10504.en: I am here.

Ncorp_10504.zh: 他们将无法回归泥土。
Ncorp_10504.en: They shan’t rest beneath the earth.

Ncorp_10504.zh: 请您下令。
Ncorp_10504.en: I heed your words.

Ncorp_10504.zh: 汝须忏悔。
Ncorp_10504.en: You shall repent.

Ncorp_10504.zh: 无意义的抵抗。
Ncorp_10504.en: A worthless resistance.

Ncorp_10504.zh: 信仰太过贫乏。
Ncorp_10504.en: Such feeble faith.

Ncorp_10504.zh: 异端已被净化。
Ncorp_10504.en: The heretic has been purged.

Ncorp_10504.zh: 锤们……将追赶汝等直至终末……
Ncorp_10504.en: The hammer… shall pursue you to the end…

Ncorp_10504.zh: 因执柄者命我取得成功。
Ncorp_10504.en: For the One Who Grips had ordered me to succeed.

Ncorp_10504.zh: 虽然我已尽微薄之力……
Ncorp_10504.en: It was the fault of my inability.

Ncorp_10504.zh: 若执柄者满意，那便足矣。
Ncorp_10504.en: If the One Who Grips is satisfied, that is enough for me.

Ncorp_10504.zh: 我会将这辉煌胜果献与执柄者。
Ncorp_10504.en: I devote this superb victory to the One Who Grips.

Ncorp_10504.zh: 此皆为……我羸弱之过……
Ncorp_10504.en: It is all… the fault of my weakness…

Rcorp_10506.zh: 准备完毕。我来打头阵。
Rcorp_10506.en: I'm ready. Let me take the vanguard.

Rcorp_10506.zh: 每当清晨苏醒，都如同重新孵化一般。
Rcorp_10506.en: Every morning, I feel as though I am newly hatched.

Rcorp_10506.zh: 正午，是进行机动训练的时间。午饭，已简单解决。
Rcorp_10506.en: It's afternoon—time for maneuver training. As for lunch, I had something simple.

Rcorp_10506.zh: 夜晚会让我回忆起那些被筛选时的记忆。
Rcorp_10506.en: Nighttime brings back memories of my selection.

Rcorp_10506.zh:
您问这套装甲……？十分抱歉。但只有犀牛队才能使用这套装甲。
重量是问题之一，若是想要感应生物电流则需要实施另外的手术，否则连移动都无法做到。
Rcorp_10506.en:
This suit...? I'm sorry, but only the Rhino Team can use this suit.
You won't be able to lift a finger without a special procedure allowing your bioelectricity to be detected by the suit, much less endure the suit's weight.

Rcorp_10506.zh: 我们在战斗中位当先锋。为了协助者们，我们会弹开一切并摧毁敌方阵线。
Rcorp_10506.en: We are vanguards of the battlefield. We defend those who work with us and disrupt the enemy lines.

Rcorp_10506.zh:
虽然训练看似特别频繁……但这全都有必要。不可预料的部署随时可能发生。
……然而，很少有人积极参加训练。
Rcorp_10506.en:
The training may appear excessively frequent... yet it is all necessary. Unforeseen deployment may happen at any time.
...Not many of them appear enthusiastic, however.

Rcorp_10506.zh:
缺乏战斗经验的情况……事实上并不常见。因为一旦加入R公司，就会过分地积累那些经验……
我不想再回想起那些。
Rcorp_10506.en:
To be frank, not many are lacking in combat experience. Joining R Corp. means that you'll soon have plenty of it, that's why...
I don't wish to recall them, however.

Rcorp_10506.zh:
由我亲手摧毁自己，真是不快的经历。虽然我充分了解其必要性，并且可以理解……
希望您永远不会经历这些。
Rcorp_10506.en:
Breaking and bursting myself is an awfully unpleasant experience. I do understand its necessity, however...
I hope you won't ever experience it yourself.

Rcorp_10506.zh: 这个时间适合进行一些无氧锻炼。
Rcorp_10506.en: This seems like a good time to do some anaerobic exercise.

Rcorp_10506.zh: 我明白了。我会带来与您支援一样有效的结果。
Rcorp_10506.en: Understood. I will bring you results that are as good as your support.

Rcorp_10506.zh: 部署完成。
Rcorp_10506.en: Deployment.

Rcorp_10506.zh: 装甲增压……施行。
Rcorp_10506.en: Commencing... suit pressurization.

Rcorp_10506.zh: 此处危险。
Rcorp_10506.en: It's not safe here.

Rcorp_10506.zh: 哈！
Rcorp_10506.en: Haah!

Rcorp_10506.zh: 对方阵线崩溃。
Rcorp_10506.en: Their lines are broken.
Hnnh...

Rcorp_10506.zh: 已确认生命活动停止。
Rcorp_10506.en: Confirming cessation of biological activity.

Rcorp_10506.zh: 啊……又需要重新筛选吗……
Rcorp_10506.en: Ah... must I repeat the selection process...?

Rcorp_10506.zh: 是筛选而出之人的成果。
Rcorp_10506.en: Selecting me brings success.

Rcorp_10506.zh: 未能预测到……这种情况。
Rcorp_10506.en: I did not anticipate... this outcome.

Rcorp_10506.zh: 不错的成果。今日的不足之处我会通过训练补足。
Rcorp_10506.en: An adequate result. I will make up for the mistakes today with additional training.

Rcorp_10506.zh: 完美的成果。是孵化场严格筛选的结果。
Rcorp_10506.en: A flawless result. An outcome made possible by the rigorous selection process of the Hatchery.

Rcorp_10506.zh: 战斗经验……依旧有所欠缺……我会再次被送进孵化场吧……
Rcorp_10506.en: I lacked... combat experience... I will be sent back to the Hatchery, then...

Rings_10515.zh: 向着比起功能更优先表现素材原貌的方向。让其表面的粘合染色方式更加突出尸体痉挛。是。我会按照反馈，补全缺陷之处。讲解员大人。
Rings_10515.en: Prioritize the rawness of the medium over functionality, apply the bonding pigment in a way that accentuates the cadaveric spasms—Understood, Docent. The impressions highlighted in your feedback will all be addressed.

Rings_10515.zh:
我在……观察放血。这是以自然方式处理夜间采集到的素材的必经步骤。
据说在现出锐利冷光的黎明至清晨时最适合进行这项工作。因此，我总偏好在这一时间进行。
Rings_10515.en:
I was observing the... phlebotomization process. Material collected overnight necessitates this preliminary step before it can be conditioned in a more natural method.
According to the lessons, the transitory span between dawn and sunrise is the most apt time to conduct this work, for the light takes on a razor-fine blue tone. That is why I make frequent use of it.

Rings_10515.zh: 如果还不熟悉，建议您不要在用餐时参观我们的工作。为了原封不动地保留素材原始的质感，我们不会进行任何防腐或防臭处理……啊。洗手间就在外面。
Rings_10515.en: Observing our work process over a meal is generally not recommended to individuals unacquainted with our studio environment. To preserve the ingredients' raw purity, we refrain from processing them with antiseptics or deodorization chemicals, which means—ah. The restroom is outside.

Rings_10515.zh:
失礼了。我原本在进行夜间作业，但没想到会到这么晚。预计在今天完成的课题形式不论怎样……都似乎与评价标准不符，因此正在进行调整。
嗯。感谢您“还不错”的评价。但作业无法基于这样的主观评价进行。
Rings_10515.en:
Pardon me. I was engaged in a late-night session refining my work and did not expect to see you here at this hour. This is the assignment to be completed today—I am applying some final revisions so that the outcome may be more... consistent with the evaluation criteria.
Mm. The evaluation "this looks fine" is appreciated. However, such a subjective assessment cannot serve as a standard for my work to continue.

Rings_10515.zh:
个人意见并不重要。重大失误是我完成了与野兽派的传统相悖的课题吧。
我会尝试将以其他动物的素材加固的部分移除，代以其原有的肌腱层层叠加而加固。
Rings_10515.en:
Subjectivity is not a matter of concern. The critical failing of my assignment was that it violated the traditional tenets of Fauvism.
Any parts reinforced by materials taken from other animals will be removed and replaced with overlaid tendons from the primary ingredient.

Rings_10515.zh:
虽然依照理论完成得很好，但缺乏强烈感。在我得到的三十七次评价内，这一评价共记录了二十一次。虽然我从未得过不及格，但也总难以使所有评分超过B-。
虽然作品完全符合理论以及评分标准，但我难以理解为什么会得到这样的结果。
Rings_10515.en:
"Good demonstration of art theory and practice, but lacks punch." 21 of 37 critiques of my work contained this evaluation. I haven't yet received a failing grade, but it is difficult to score above B- in all assignments.
This piece, too, was produced in perfect compliance with the required technique and review criteria—it is difficult to discern the reasoning behind this evaluation.

Rings_10515.zh:
所谓源远流长的思潮，意味着其核心思想长久以来都不曾变化。野兽派也正是因此而得到赞扬。
如此看来，那些毫无底线地将各式思潮杂糅到一起的人所代表的思潮，自然无法称得上优秀。
Rings_10515.en:
Fauvism is often described as a time-honored movement. This suggests that its foundations have remained stable for many years—this continuity likely underlies its acclaim.
Therefore, the natural conclusion is that the movement practiced by the one who had attempted to overlay one over the other without regard for their defining principles must be deemed substandard at best.

Rings_10515.zh:
采集素材时，最好在先充分观察素材的生态后再开始。踏出脚步时摇晃的皮毛的流动性，瞄准猎物时露出的眼神以及滴落的唾液。
以及，在捕食者面前无措地放弃一切抵抗时那筋骨的松弛等。
Rings_10515.en:
When selecting the medium, it is paramount that its habitat is sufficiently observed prior to procurement. Subjects of interest may include the following: how its hide and fur move in accordance with ambulation, how its eyes and maw gleam and drool when stalking the prey...
And how its body relaxes in surrender when faced with an inescapable predator.

Rings_10515.zh:
“世上无恶犬。”这是我从处理、加工、穿着大量素材的经验中得出并铭记的感受。
其中最为美丽的便是前爪那宏伟而大胆的表现。然后是决定跃起的犬只那咯吱作响的獠牙……敬请观赏。《最好之犬》。
Rings_10515.en:
"There is no such thing as a bad dog." This is the impression I have gained over the course of working with, processing, and wearing countless iterations of the medium.
It is said that a canine's forepaw is the most beautiful, and its fangs the most fierce—my work invites you to observe the broad, bold strokes in the former... and the impression of a determined, decisive leap in the latter.
I present... "Man's Best Dog."

Rings_10515.zh: 必须修补素材缺损的部位。还需要扩张肌纤维以及重新填充黏着针的颜料。
Rings_10515.en: Any absent parts of the medium must be patched. Needles for myofiber expansion-and-adhesion must also be refilled with their paint.

Rings_10515.zh:
嗯。爪间毫无空隙。存在着……意图抓紧猎物，将其攥入掌中的激情。这次创作的作品似乎可以提交审查。
……是啊。趁此机会，为下一件作品收集新素材或许也不错。
Rings_10515.en:
Hm. Loose claws: addressed. The excitement of the subject about to grip the prey in its claws: ... clearly communicated. This particular iteration is now worthy of submission for evaluation.
... In that case, now would be the opportune time to collect new material for my next piece.

Rings_10515.zh: 试展的日程决定了吗。
Rings_10515.en: I take it that we have a date for the trial exhibition.

Rings_10515.zh: 期待您的严正审查。
Rings_10515.en: Requesting your most rigorous evaluation.

Rings_10515.zh: 想让面对猎物的犬只停下的话……！
Rings_10515.en: Tugging a hound's leash before its prey is—!

Rings_10515.zh: 野性地(Sauvage)！
Rings_10515.en: C'est sauvage!

Rings_10515.zh: 如果彻底掌握犬类这一素材，
Rings_10515.en: Once the canine material has been mastered,

Rings_10515.zh: 呜，但课题……
Rings_10515.en: Ngh, but the assignment—

Rings_10515.zh: 下次，我想尝试以你为素材。
Rings_10515.en: I would like to work with you for my next project.

Rings_10515.zh: 散发出死亡气息的……是，我的……作品啊。
Rings_10515.en: The fetor of death... was myself as the artwork... all along.

Rings_10515.zh: 这种时候，似乎很适合摇动尾巴。
Rings_10515.en: Perhaps the tail is to be wagged at such an occasion.

Rings_10515.zh: 很抱歉。这和我的素材并不契合。
Rings_10515.en: Apologies. This does not align with my subject matter.

Rings_10515.zh: 这次也是及格分，但得分并不高。本以为我已经吸纳了全部反馈……问题在于我无法想到其他改进方式。
Rings_10515.en: A passing grade, but not a good one. All of the feedback has already been applied, but the issue persists: I cannot think of additional ideas to improve this assignment.

Rings_10515.zh:
B+……虽然微妙，但也确实前进了一步。分析哪些因素提高了评分需要花费一些时间。
……嗯。在战斗中我曾暂时失去理智，彻底地投入。可惜没能保留那时的记忆。
Rings_10515.en:
B+... That is indeed a step forward, however small it may be. I must conduct an analysis of this performance to identify the causes of this elevated scoring.
... Hm, I did briefly lose my reason and enter the proverbial "zone" mid-battle. It is a shame that I cannot fully recall the memories of that experience.

Rings_10515.zh: C+……啊，讲解员大人。恕我失礼，您对于这次评分的建议是……<color=#923838>哈。亲爱的，你真觉得这种照搬形式的作品……能表现出野性吗？</color>如果能指出让您有这类感觉的部分，我下次会定量地将那部分……<color=#923838>啊。算了。不明白的话就试试和野兽们一起住进动物园呢？</color>
Rings_10515.en: C+... Ah, Docent. If I may... Could you provide additional elaboration on your evaluation of my— *sigh* Darling, lemme ask ya one thing—just what part of an art that so obediently conforms to the mold do ya think demonstrates the concept of le Fauve? If you would so graciously indicate the precise aspects your evaluation addresses, then I will better them by a quantifiable measure of— Ugh, forget it. If ya really, really don't get it, why don'tcha try rolling in the mud with zoo animals?

SwordGroup_10508.zh: 不准备行动吗。嗯。我们正处于不得不落子的局面。
SwordGroup_10508.en: We are not placing our stone here, then? Mm, then the tides drive us to resign.

SwordGroup_10508.zh: 一日之计在于晨。有许多事需要思考，也有许多事需要做。
SwordGroup_10508.en: A morning must start early. There is much to process and much to do.

SwordGroup_10508.zh:
如果日程上有空余，来下一盘如何。我需要一些时间来整理思绪。
因为需要考虑寻找我们的栖身之所。
SwordGroup_10508.en:
Would you join me for a round of baduk if there is a vacancy in your schedule? I require some time to systemize my thoughts.
I must contemplate where I may find our new home.

SwordGroup_10508.zh: 月光皎洁时需时刻留心。将身上伤痕曝露在外并非好事。
SwordGroup_10508.en: Always remain watchful under a bright moonlight. One must keep their wounds and scars out of sight.

SwordGroup_10508.zh: 使剑时不能犹豫。如果有所踌躇……说明对剑的掌握仍不够熟练。需要勤加练习。
SwordGroup_10508.en: Do not hesitate when wielding a blade, for hesitation is a sign of an underdeveloped familiarity with the blade. Train yourself to reach greater heights.

SwordGroup_10508.zh:
围棋是适合观察对手会如何战斗的游戏。
通过博弈，自然而然便能读懂对手行动中的想法。
SwordGroup_10508.en:
One can learn the opponent's strategies by playing a game of baduk with them.
The further the game progresses, the more moves the opponent makes, the easier it becomes to read them.

SwordGroup_10508.zh:
大乱迫在眉睫。我被委任为护卫，理当尽职到最后……但那样一来，或许会失去在S公司的立足之地。
必须守护的那位大人，我与我的友人们，都会如此。
SwordGroup_10508.en:
I expect that turmoil shall visit us soon. I have been tasked with the role of a protector, so I shall do my duty to the bitter end. 
...Yet I foresee that my fellows, the one I must protect, and I may lose my place at S Corp.

SwordGroup_10508.zh: 曾有人说我会像流浪者一样过活时，我嗤之以鼻……可如今，我似乎行将踏上四处漂泊的人生了。
SwordGroup_10508.en: When someone had once told me that I would live the life of a vagrant, I had scoffed at the notion. ... I suppose I shall truly live a life of a wanderer, now.

SwordGroup_10508.zh:
肉斩，骨断。即必须全神贯注，直击对手要害。
我会让您亲眼见证，亲身体验。
SwordGroup_10508.en: Tear the flesh and hew the bones. In other words, one must maintain utmost focus until the blade cleaves clean through the bones. I will demonstrate, and you will learn.

SwordGroup_10508.zh: ……嗯。我会开始读秒。
SwordGroup_10508.en: ... Mm. I will start the countdown.

SwordGroup_10508.zh:
无论派来多少刺客，对我而言最终都是棋盘上的前一步。
我这一步尚未结束……您会回应吗？
SwordGroup_10508.en:
No matter how many assassins they send, they are nothing before me but the placement of a single stone in a game of baduk.
My play has yet to flourish... will you respond nevertheless?

SwordGroup_10508.zh: 于星位落子吧。
SwordGroup_10508.en: I place my stone at a flower point.

SwordGroup_10508.zh: 试着。
SwordGroup_10508.en: My play.

SwordGroup_10508.zh: 多管闲事属于大忌。
SwordGroup_10508.en: I will not accept any unsolicited advice.

SwordGroup_10508.zh: 如要斩，则需赌上性命。
SwordGroup_10508.en: If you will cut... then wager your life on it.

SwordGroup_10508.zh: 肉斩，
SwordGroup_10508.en: Yield the flesh.

SwordGroup_10508.zh: 死棋……吗。
SwordGroup_10508.en: A defeat of my own making...

SwordGroup_10508.zh: 骨断。
SwordGroup_10508.en: To claim the bones.

SwordGroup_10508.zh: 啊……我无颜面对……友人们。
SwordGroup_10508.en: Ah... how will I stand tall before my... fellows...?

SwordGroup_10508.zh: 一着妙手。
SwordGroup_10508.en: A wise move.

SwordGroup_10508.zh: 一着恶手。
SwordGroup_10508.en: A witless move.

SwordGroup_10508.zh: 激烈的一战，结果很好。这样一来我们也能有活路了。
SwordGroup_10508.en: The endgame of this match was close yet conclusive. We may now freely seek the path to our survival.

SwordGroup_10508.zh: 决胜之策奏效了。局势已经完全倒向我方。愿在找到栖身之所前，不要失去这股势头。
SwordGroup_10508.en: My stratagem worked, and the tide of this battle was in our favor. Let this tide continue until we find us a new home.

SwordGroup_10508.zh: 失着。身体尚需多刻上一道刀痕。
SwordGroup_10508.en: I must have made a losing move. Thus I yield my flesh to another scar.

Thumb_10512.zh: 我建议你考虑再三后再和我搭话。我今天拔下的舌头已经够多了。
Thumb_10512.en: Think it over three times, hard, before talking to me. I have ripped out enough tongues today.

Thumb_10512.zh:
从已准备完毕的人开始早间汇报。正如我常言那般，“准备”一词囊括着各类程序。
目的与方法，过程与结果……以及在那一切之上的礼仪。不能牢记于心的人，也没有系命于身的必要。
Thumb_10512.en: Commence morning reports, starting from whoever is ready. And as I have said many times in the past, the state of being 'ready' entails various steps and procedures: purpose, method, process, outcome... and, most importantly, the all-encompassing adherence to manners. Those who are not 'ready' based on this criterion will be deemed unworthy of life.

Thumb_10512.zh:
已经到了正午却还没有把这里收拾好吗。我记得我明确说过之后有重要的谈话，需要尽快处理。
……嗯，连杂役也死了吗。那没办法了，谈话时的威势也可算是重要因素吧。
Thumb_10512.en:
It's noon, and the trash is still here... I remember insisting that these must be cleaned up, as I expect to welcome an important client here.
... Hm, no one left for the clean-up either, I see. I suppose intimidation factors can also be significant elements in these consultations.

Thumb_10512.zh:
你似乎不觉得深夜拜访是件不合礼仪之事。哪怕你的地位足以让你与我目光相对……
好吧。如果是您，即使是深更半夜我也仍应以礼相迎。还请您原谅我的无礼。
Thumb_10512.en:
Do you not think that it is quite unmannerly to visit me so late into the night? Even if your station grants you the right to look me right in the eyes...
... I see. Then the manners would dictate that you deserve to be welcomed here at this hour. I apologize for my discourtesy.

Thumb_10512.zh:
虽已预料到史家将委托我们，却没想到会与如此上位之人直接接洽。
听到单独会面的要求时，我多少也能猜到对方的大致地位……嗯，但没想到来的会是您。
Thumb_10512.en:
A contract from the Shi family was expected, but a visitation from someone of such distinguished rank... was not.
I could deduce by the fact that this individual requested a private meeting that it would be one with an esteemed position, but... hm. I certainly did not expect you.

Thumb_10512.zh:
浸泡着两颗牙齿的红酒在此刻可算是优美的结合。几乎可以称之为艺术。
……嗯。因为最近去蜘蛛巢露了脸，自言自语的情况增加了。没想到会说出艺术之类的话。遣词造句应当合乎己位……那才是，拇指的指挥官。
Thumb_10512.en: Red wine with two freshly pulled teeth makes for a good pairing, a mariage with this particular circumstance. Almost like a work of art. ... Hm. It seems that my recent visit to the House of Spiders has affected my speech. To use words like 'art'... is not befitting the Capo of the Thumb.

Thumb_10512.zh:
一枚虎标弹，等价于三支这样的最高级雪茄。装满弹药后释放的斩击，就像是将雪茄与雪茄盒一起消耗殆尽一样……
不过偶尔，也可能遇到比这一盒雪茄更有价值的对手，那么太过节省才是不值得。
Thumb_10512.en:
The value of a single Tigermark Round is equivalent to the value of three of these premium cigars. Slashing at my foe by consuming every ammunition in its chambers is like losing an entire humidor's worth of cigars, yet...
... sometimes, a good fight is worth more than a bundle of cigars. I would be remiss to let this chance pass in favor of frugality.

Thumb_10512.zh: ……看来不是浪费我子弹的家伙。那么我就尽情挥刀吧。真是少见地……令我心潮澎湃。
Thumb_10512.en:
... I see that you are worth the cost of my ammunition. Prepare to face my unmitigated might.
This 'excitement'... what a rare sensation.

Thumb_10512.zh:
想擒虎吗。那就做好被咬死的觉悟吧。
我，默尔索。拇指的指挥官，东部十剑之一。将全力与你战斗。
Thumb_10512.en:
One mustn't embark on a tiger hunt without preparing to be mauled by its teeth. I presume that you feel ready, then?
I am Meursault. Capo of the Thumb, one of the Ten Blades of the East. I will now meet you in battle with all my might.

Thumb_10512.zh: 没错，你的判断很明智，就算有话想说也没有直接向我搭话。让阶级高于你又在我之下的人来传话吧。
Thumb_10512.en: It was an astute decision on your end to not address me directly. Find a superior of yours who is inferior to my station to relay your message.

Thumb_10512.zh: 虽然必须隐瞒这把天退星刀的名号略微有些可惜……但既然它能如插翅之虎一般咆哮，那如此倒也足够。
Thumb_10512.en: The fact that the name of Tiantui Star's blade must remain hidden is a shame, indeed... but here, that want is fulfilled by another—that I may roar like a winged tiger. This sates me.

Thumb_10512.zh: 你最好把我送到了与我相称的地方。
Thumb_10512.en: You best hope that this task is worthy of my presence.

Thumb_10512.zh: 猎物吗。令人……热血沸腾啊。
Thumb_10512.en: Off to hunt, then? Oh, good... I'm burning up.

Thumb_10512.zh: ……你难道分不清上下级关系吗。
Thumb_10512.en: ... The concept of manners must be alien to you.

Thumb_10512.zh: 接一招试试吧？
Thumb_10512.en: Are you ready?

Thumb_10512.zh: 就这水平吗？
Thumb_10512.en: Is this really your best?

Thumb_10512.zh: 咳呵……还，有点意思。
Thumb_10512.en: Keh... Why, that's quite good.

Thumb_10512.zh: 再那样呆站着，脑袋可要落地了。
Thumb_10512.en: Standing around as you did is what cost you your head.

Thumb_10512.zh: 呼……他妈的……
Thumb_10512.en: Puff... motherfucker...

Thumb_10512.zh: 这最好算是委托。如果只是个要求，我就砍掉你的两条胳膊。
Thumb_10512.en: This better have been a contract. I may have to remove both of your arms if it was an insolent request.

Thumb_10512.zh: ……作为委托失败的补偿，我会留你一命。
Thumb_10512.en: ... I will not be taking your life. As a compensation for failing this mission.

Thumb_10512.zh: 真是，不成体统。你们就这种水平吗。说出你们上司的名字和地址。不带着那人的脑袋回去都不算值得。
Thumb_10512.en:
Disappointing. Is this really your best?
Give me the name and the location of your superior. I must claim their head to make this worth the effort.

Thumb_10512.zh: 能让我兴奋的事物并不多……不过这次恰好是宝贵的其中之一。难得让我好好消遣了一番。未能回收的弹壳……就当作小费吧。
Thumb_10512.en:
There are not many things in this world that excite me. However... this is one of those rare cases.
I enjoyed this dance. Keep any bullet casings I missed—consider them a tip.

Thumb_10512.zh:
我直截了当地问了……有能放我一条生路的办法吗。或者，报出相等的价格吧。
……如果都没有，哈。就只能献上我的脑袋了。
Thumb_10512.en:
Let me be straightforward. Is there any means by which I may survive this encounter? Or, if a monetary compensation would suffice, then provide a number.
... If not, then... hah. It seems that I must lose my head.

Wcorp_10503.zh: 请告诉我目的地吧，我将为您提供指引。
Wcorp_10503.en: Tell me your destination, and I’ll guide you there.

Wcorp_10503.zh: 我无法理解的事情很多，上班迟到就是其中之一。我认为准时到岗是员工的基本要求。
Wcorp_10503.en: There are many things I fail to comprehend, and those who are late to work are one of them. I believe timely arrival is a basic requirement for an employee to meet.

Wcorp_10503.zh: 我总在这时晒太阳。可能是还没有习惯随时都能沐浴阳光这件事吧。
Wcorp_10503.en: I often expose myself to sunlight at this hour. It may be attributed to the fact that the nature of my occupation prevented me from seeing it frequently.

Wcorp_10503.zh: 很少有人喜欢和我对话。与他们截然不同的经理你应该是个特别的人吧。
Wcorp_10503.en: Few people enjoy conversing with me. That would make you a strange one, Manager.

Wcorp_10503.zh: 我对尸体很熟悉。然而熟悉不代表喜欢。
Wcorp_10503.en: I am familiar with dead bodies. Familiarity does not assure pleasantness, however.

Wcorp_10503.zh: 堂吉诃德说她加入W公司很自豪。我觉得这有些不可思议。
Wcorp_10503.en: Don Quixote says she is proud to have joined W Corp. I found that rather curious.

Wcorp_10503.zh: 如果您要乘坐WARP列车，可以提前告诉我。我会亲自收集您的碎片。
Wcorp_10503.en: If you’re ever taking a WARP train, you may let me know, Manager. I will personally pick up your pieces.

Wcorp_10503.zh: 如果与人共情确实有那么重要……他们就应该把这条在公司条例里写清楚。
Wcorp_10503.en: If it is actually that important to empathize with others… they should have stated as much in the company guidelines.

Wcorp_10503.zh: W公司的辞职人数在一众企业中尤其多。那些来辞职的人总是一副涕泪横流的模样，我没有费劲去理解他们的行为。
Wcorp_10503.en: W Corp. saw particularly many resignations. The quitting employees always had copious amounts of tears and saliva about their faces. I did not make an active effort to comprehend their behavior.

Wcorp_10503.zh: 请确保准时归来。
Wcorp_10503.en: Do make sure to return in time.

Wcorp_10503.zh: 晋升……我习惯了。
Wcorp_10503.en: Promotions… That, I am used to.

Wcorp_10503.zh: 了解。我会将你送达目的地。
Wcorp_10503.en: Understood, I’ll get you to your destination.

Wcorp_10503.zh: 向目的地出发。
Wcorp_10503.en: Onto our destination.

Wcorp_10503.zh: 你确实是个特别的人。
Wcorp_10503.en: You are certainly a peculiar individual.

Wcorp_10503.zh: 扫除障碍。
Wcorp_10503.en: Removing obstacles.

Wcorp_10503.zh: 我不觉得很好笑。
Wcorp_10503.en: I am not particularly amused.

Wcorp_10503.zh: 哼！
Wcorp_10503.en: Hmpfh!

Wcorp_10503.zh: 我没有收集这些尸体的必要。
Wcorp_10503.en: I won’t have to collect these remains.

Wcorp_10503.zh: 我过后会收集遗体。
Wcorp_10503.en: I’ll collect their remains later.

Wcorp_10503.zh: 只是按图索骥罢了。
Wcorp_10503.en: I merely followed the procedures.

Wcorp_10503.zh: 这没在规定之中写明。
Wcorp_10503.en: This was not in the procedures.

Wcorp_10503.zh: 这里的尸体比我处理过的更结实一些。
Wcorp_10503.en: The corpses here are more durable than what I work with.

Wcorp_10503.zh: 他们已经全部被分割成合理大小了。
Wcorp_10503.en: All of them have been segmented into adequate pieces.

Wcorp_10503.zh: 熟悉练习是必要的一步。
Wcorp_10503.en: It’s a necessary step for familiarization.

ego.zh: 我将会为你祈祷，因此你势必粉身碎骨。
ego.en: I will pray for you, so that you shall surely break.
Before anyone else, you… shan’t pardon me.

ego.zh: 这身约束衣，根本就不足以……阻止我施暴。
ego.en: This straight-jacket... isn't nearly enough to hold my violence back.

ego.zh: 脑袋变成……金属……大脑变得……光滑……结束、开始。结束、又开始！
ego.en: Head... turning into... metal... brain... flattened... Ends, Begins. ENDS, BEGINS!

ego.zh: 我只剩下这些电力了……咕，连这些也要……！
ego.en: This electricity is all I have left... I can't...!

ego.zh: 自血中绽放吧。美艳的花啊。我心甘情愿将你纳为己物！
ego.en:
Blossom from the blood, O beautiful flower.
I shall gladly claim you as mine!

ego.zh: 完全不够！这迫切的饥渴无法满足……将堤坝……击垮吧！以根茎贯穿吧！！！
ego.en:
More, more! This can't quench this scorching thirst...
Burst the dams...! Penetrate them with the roots!!!

ego.zh:
蒸汽压缩活塞压力限制已解除，观测完成所需时间向量已计算完毕……
转换累积的过去，矩值不变……发射。
ego.en:
Steam compression piston pressure cap removed.
Observed temporal vector calculation complete...
Transform Accumulated Past; maintain moment value... Launch.

ego.zh:
压缩、压缩。忽略蒸汽逆流……无法忽略。过去已侵蚀，记忆已侵蚀。
时间逆流向使用者，咳……无法……理解……
ego.en:
Compress. Compress. Ignore steam reflux... cannot ignore.
Past corroded. Memory corroded.
User affected by temporal reflux, nngh... 
Comprehension... failure...
Awash in the yearning moonlight, I hew your throat and claim the breath that remains!
Awash in the yearning moonlight, I hew your throat!
I claim the breath that remains!

story.zh: 如果下令，我便照做。
story.en: Give the word, and we’ll do it.

story.zh: 政治宣传。可惜没什么效果。
story.en: Propaganda. His effort has regrettably ended in failure.

story.zh: 那个集装箱由色彩斑斓、形态各异且光滑的塑料制成……
story.en: It's a freight container, made of smooth plastic that comes in assorted colors.

story.zh: 因为其使用了许多怪异的材料，所以推断为并非是单纯的工厂设施。
story.en: The use of so many peculiar materials suggests that this is more than just a basic manufacturing facility.

story.zh: 脚步声。不属于人类。相当迟钝沉重。
story.en: Footfalls. Not of a human. Rather slow and heavy.

story.zh: 那样也许更好。
story.en: That may have served better.

story.zh: 经理没有嘴部。
story.en: Our manager has no mouth.

story.zh: 这个观点没错。介于我们从S公司移民而来，税收于我们而言更重。
story.en: That's a valid point. Taxes are heavier on us because we migrated from another district.

story.zh: 实际上，我们无法承担他们规定的定期支付税额。
story.en: They are demanding a fee we cannot afford to pay regularly.

story.zh: T公司……一定不乐于见到一项无需批准就可以窥视其他世界的技术诞生。
story.en: T Corp... wouldn't have been pleased with the idea of a technology capable of peeping into other worlds without permission.

story.zh: 能够窥视其他世界的技术并不是关键，问题出在其没有被批准上。
story.en: I do believe you know well enough that their problem lies with the lack of permission, not the capability of the technology.

story.zh: 我知道轮到我了。
story.en: I knew my turn would come.

story.zh: 还有……我不认为我们会再会了。
story.en: And... I don't believe we'll ever see each other again.

story.zh: T公司技术局的员工不可能追到N公司。
story.en: It's implausible for employees of T Corp's tech agency to chase him into N Corp.

story.zh: 这意味着，他们是尝试侵入自我心道的异物。
story.en: Which suggests this is a foreign substance attempting to breach into the fathoms of ego.

story.zh: 不，不睁大双眼也没问题。
story.en: No, there is no need for a search.

story.zh: 右方，400m左右。那就是我们曾乘坐的小船……
story.en: 400 meters to your right. There is the boat—

story.zh: 有必要听完陈述。船体的受损率在75%以上，其残骸散落在周围的地面上。
story.en: Allow me to finish. There is the boat in a ditch. 75% of its hull integrity has been breached and its remains are scattered on the ground.

story.zh: 他们的白化现象只进行了一部分。
story.en: Their Pallidification effects have only partially progressed.

story.zh: 我们到这里时乘坐的船只已经没有修复的可能。
story.en: The boat that carried us here is beyond salvaging.

story.zh: 因此，为了离开此处，我们需要再次准备船只。
story.en: Thus, it follows that we require a new boat for us to escape the Whale.

story.zh: 此外，进行体内的调查需要在那胃液上方移动。船只在那时也是必要的。
story.en: Moreover, moving across the bodily fluids of this Whale is necessary if we are to conduct an investigation of its interiors. For that, we require a new boat.

story.zh: 准确来说看上去像是同一只蝴蝶。
story.en: It appears to be the exact same Butterfly.

story.zh: 看上去很像寄生这种生存方式。
story.en: A form of existence similar to parasitism.

story.zh: 看来是受到了异想体的侵蚀。
story.en: They are corroded by an Abnormality.

story.zh: 推测其是由于金枝导致拉·曼却领结构改变而被卷入的。
story.en: It can be suspected that the change in La Manchaland's structure due to the influence of the Golden Bough has caused them to be swept up among the Bloodfiends.

story.zh: 确认到与其同行的名叫葆拉的人物。
story.en: I can confirm the presence of Paula, his companion.

story.zh: 没有不存在危机就能到达的目的地。
story.en: No destination was free of such risks.

story.zh: 问题似乎是，怎么做。
story.en: The question seems to be 'how'.

story.zh: 嗯。
story.en: Mm.

story.zh: 选择货币作为象征是合理的。
story.en: Then the decision to use coins as representation of tokens is symbolically appropriate.

story.zh: 已经确保了1枚铜钱的收益，如果对于让他成为同行者感到有所负担，就此别过是合理之选。
story.en: A net profit of one additional coin has already been secured. If alliance with this individual causes you concern, it would be a rational choice to simply cut ties while we are ahead.

story.zh: 但看起来孔家也曾经主动希望参与此实验。
story.en: However, it also appeared that the desire was mutually shared by the Kong family as well.

story.zh: 他的脖子上挂着与我们所收到的物品形状一致的铜钱。
story.en: The same type of coin we received at the beginning of the game is hanging from the entity's neck.

story.zh: 如果说有什么确凿的不同之处，那就是这里没有任何残留的物品。
story.en: A notable difference is that there is nothing left in here.

story.zh: ……这样。首先……
story.en: ... oom. First...
Dante~~~!

story.zh: 怎么这么慢啊？我们找了你好久！
story.en: What took ya so long? We've been lookin' all over for ya!

story.zh: 跟你说，跟你说。一觉醒来大家都乱套了呢？
story.en: Listen, Dante. You're not gonna believe this! Our bodies were switched all over the place when we woke up!

story.zh: 噗哈哈！看、看哪！尤其是那表情！啊~太好笑了……是吧，但丁？
story.en: Pfftahahaha! L-look at that! Look at that face! Holy crap, this is the funniest thing ever! Right, Dante?

story.zh: 推测发生时间是昨夜……
story.en: The suspected time of occurrence: last night—

story.zh: 呵哈，好笑得我都学不出来了~
story.en: Pffft, I can't. I just can't! How does he do that with a straight face?!

story.zh: 但丁，但丁！那个……格雷格的脸色不太好，你能去问问吗。
story.en: Dante, Dante! Greg's not looking so good... Can ya ask how he's doing?

story.zh: 啊，那个~虽然大家都是熟人……但你懂那种感觉吧？就好比吃夹心巧克力时，因为不知道里面藏着什么，而有点惴惴不安……的样子？
story.en: Ah, ya know~ I know we're not like, strangers anymore, but y'know... know what I mean? That funny feeling where when ya bite into one of those special chocolates with something in 'em, but ya don't really know what that something is or where that something is, so ya can't help but feel slightly iffy about giving it a full bite...? I think? Does that make sense?

story.zh: 嗯~我赞成良秀的想法。
story.en: Mm~ I'll go with Ryōshū.

story.zh: 当然是现在的良秀啦~再保持这样久一点如何？也算是一种转换心情吧……
story.en: The one who's Ryōshū right now, 'course~ Can't we just stay like this for a little longer? Kinda feels like a breath of fresh air, don't it...?

story.zh: 嗯？怎么，默尔待在我身体里的时候不是很有趣吗？
story.en: Huh? What, don'tcha like my body, Meur?

story.zh: 啊~我是不是该喊你罗佳啊？这太有趣了！
story.en: Ooh~ Or do I call ya Rodya? Gosh, this is so much fun!

story.zh: 不，所以你是觉得有趣~还是无趣~？
story.en: Yeah, whatevs. Is it fun~ or is it not~?

story.zh: 但丁~鸿璐他呀，总是说要死·活，要劝住真是费了九牛二虎之力啊~
story.en: Dante~ Gosh, Hong Lu kept insisting that we employ the 'D.R.D.R.' method, so it took us some effort to hold 'em back~

story.zh: 哎呀~维吉，这么看上去真是太可爱了吧~
story.en: My my my~ Verg! You're so cute like this~

story.zh: 将执行经理调整到比以前更靠后的位置，应该就能排除今后的危险因素。
story.en: Extending the distance between the manager and the battlefield in future battles would be an effective means of minimizing certain risk factors.

story.zh: 园长大人。
story.en: Principal.

story.zh: 在这里。
story.en: Down here.

story.zh: 是我。菜肴都准备好了，由我来叫园长大人。
story.en: That is me. The meal is now prepared. I have come to fetch you, Principal.

story.zh: 感谢您的称赞。
story.en: Thank you for the compliment.

story.zh: 由我来带领企鹅班的小朋友前往活动场所，希望您能坐在厨房的监护席上监督我们。
story.en: I will lead the Perky Penguins to the venue. Seat yourself at the chaperone's chair in the kitchen and oversee the proceedings.

story.zh: 狱儿园班长奥提斯已经就位。
story.en: Sinnerling Outis, the Class Captain, is already at the venue.

story.zh: 是。我们准备了油杂小凤。
story.en: We have prepared a Bongy Fwit.

story.zh: 是，园长大人。由于罗佳同学有会在烹饪期间使原材料出现持续损失的倾向，因此有意将其排除在外。
story.en: Allow me to explain, Principal. Sinnerling Rodya was intentionally excluded from the cooking process under suspicion of causing a repeated loss of ingredients.

story.zh: 现在，又有一根小凤的琵琶腿被消耗掉了。
story.en: She has just consumed another one of the Bongy drumsticks.

story.zh: 是。作为今日特供的是……
story.en: Yes. As today's ordorbrr...

story.zh: 今日的主菜。
story.en: Le Plat-doo-joor.

story.zh: ……烂泥炸小凤。
story.en: ... Mashy Fried Bongy.

story.zh: 这里离目标位置仍有15%的距离。为了后续的日程，至少再前进3%以上才较为理想。
story.en: We’re approximately 15% short of the target location. Considering our schedule, proceeding at least 3% farther would be ideal.

story.zh: 经理，您辛苦了。今日的值班……
story.en: Bonsoir, Manager, and thank you for today’s work. As for tonight’s watch…

story.zh: 现在并不是夜晚。至少在沿岸一带，这一点非常明显。
story.en: The night is not here. That is very apparent, at least in this coastal area.

story.zh: 嗯。
story.en: Hm.

story.zh: 准确地说是完全一致。
story.en: It is identical.

story.zh: 虽然对比来看有复数重叠的形状这类不同之处，但设计基调一致。
story.en: It appears that different shapes are overlapping over the door, but all of them are of the same design.

story.zh: 从巢直接进入巢的许可，比经由后巷进入的审查条件更为宽松。
story.en: I would also like to highlight that the immigration process is significantly more lenient when one is migrating from a Nest to a Nest than it is when migrating from the Backstreets to a Nest territory.

story.zh: 重组是否意味着现有的分类被重新分类？或者这是否意味着将增加一个新的等级？
story.en: I must inquire what exactly this 'overhaul' entails. Does this mean that the Abnormalities will be re-categorized within the preexisting framework of categorization? Or will additional Risk Level categories be created?

story.zh: 安静。是异想体。
story.en: Quiet. There's an Abnormality.

story.zh: 其尚未注意到我们的存在。经理，建议您做好战斗准备。
story.en: We are yet to be discovered. I recommend that we prepare for combat, Manager.

story.zh: ……此后为了防止突发事件，我需要附加一些前言。
story.en: ... I will add a preamble in the future to prevent such outbursts.

story.zh: 嗯。尚未以正确的评级标记罪种，可供自行判断的情报减少。
story.en: Mm. The lack of precise tiered labeling system means that it is difficult for one to make a subjective judgment.

story.zh: 我来读吧。
story.en: I will read them.

story.zh: ……我明白了。我会先读完，再总结其内容。
story.en: ... Understood. In that case, I will instead peruse the document first and produce a comprehensive summary.

story.zh: 以上。
story.en: That is all.

story.zh: 嗯。在之前的文件中看到过，说话的似乎是一位叫作Hod的Sephirah。
story.en: Mm. It appears that the Sephirah 'Hod', whose name we first learned of in the earlier document, is the one speaking to us.

story.zh: 似乎已经掌握了目标的特征信息。
story.en: That appears to be an appropriate amount of intelligence to identify this target.

story.zh: ……嗯。基于卡车外部板材的材质与色泽进行推论，看似是定期体检时所使用的车辆型移动装置。
story.en: ... Mm. Extrapolating from the material and the color of the truck's cover panel, it can be determined that it is the same transportation device used for the regular check-up.

story.zh: 这句话意味着此后的异想体管理并不能单单依靠调整理智值解决。
story.en: You are implying that the management of Abnormalities entail something far more complicated than simply calibrating their sanity at a reasonable level.

story.zh: 像身份这种基本个人信息，可以在死亡报告中轻松掌握。
story.en: Basic personal information, such as one’s identity, can be easily acquired from the registration of one’s death.

story.zh: 我知道那一般是人变化成难以被称为“人类”的形态的现象。原因不明，形态变化也多种多样。
story.en: To my knowledge, it is a phenomenon where an individual morphs into a form often unfit to be considered “human”. It has no known causes, and the appearances were all different.

story.zh: 不，扭曲不会像异想体一样变成卵，而是会彻底死亡。
story.en: Not exactly, as unlike Abnormalities, they do not shrink into eggs; it is possible for them to fully expire.

story.zh: 以前，我曾见过数次。
story.en: I have witnessed a number of cases in the past.

story.zh: 观察到脸部遮盖着不明面具者们。
story.en: I see individuals covering their heads with strange masks.

story.zh: ……这动静赶得上审问敌军俘虏了。
story.en: …The sound of the impacts was comparable to when she was interrogating a captive enemy.

story.zh: 我只是认为前往人数较少的一方有助于正确的均衡。
story.en: I have only done so because joining the team with fewer members would set the balance right.

story.zh: 这个餐厅……散发着至少有140天没有清扫过的臭味。
story.en: …This restaurant reeks of mold and other uncleaned stains. It is likely that the kitchen has been left unattended for at least 140 days.

story.zh: 比起在这，出去做料理在卫生上应当更加安全。
story.en: Cooking outside may be more sanitary to the current situation.
The…

story.zh: 整体上调味太过分散不协调；鸡肉没有用合适的火候烹熟，没能完全去除鸡肉的腥味和杂味；酱汁过于黏稠，鸡肉味道寡淡；刀工随意且不整齐，摆盘无法勾起食用者的食欲。
story.en: The dressing is erroneous overall; failure to properly cook the chicken has resulted in a residual stench of blood and other unpleasant odors; the sauce is too thick to bring out a deep flavor; the inconsistent cuts of the meat contribute to the serving’s inability to rouse one’s appetite.

story.zh: 不。
story.en: Non.

story.zh: 我还没有说完。
story.en: I have not finished.

story.zh: 调味和香料简直一团糟，吃到嘴里还不如一块石膏。你因为砂糖不够而加入了两勺半黄油作为调料，而这些让口味直接落入了下水道。
story.en: The seasons and spices are a complete disaster, and the taste in my mouth is even worse than plaster. Lacking sugar, you tossed two and a half spoons of butter, and the end result simply belongs right in the gutter.

story.zh: 李箱，如同你的名字一样，料理被你搞成了破灭的理想，它让我的口腔感受到了死亡，你打算让我得胃溃疡，还是想让我变遗像？我要就此离场，以上。
story.en: Yi Sang. I must ask if you aim to throng my teeth and prong my tongue by cooking wrong—seeing as this plate’s a headstrong lens to ding-dong notions of what food is to you all along.

story.zh: 对大多数人而言，我说的话越详细，他们就越无法理解我的核心论点。
story.en: Most people were unable to accept my point when I elaborated on my statements in detail.

story.zh: 因此，至今为止我一直刻意不让自己的言辞过于冗长。
story.en: Because of that, I have not bothered to expand upon them until now.

story.zh: 此外……
story.en: Additionally…

story.zh: ……我不喜欢有助手在旁。
story.en: …I do not prefer to have assistants around.

story.zh: 嗯……虽然烹饪不是我的专业领域，但如果你们坚持的话，我很乐意试一试。
story.en: Hmm… Cooking is not my specialty, but if you so insist, I will readily attempt it.

story.zh: 土豆必须准确地切成正方形，才能使每面均匀受热直至完全熟透。
story.en: Potatoes should be cut into square pieces so that they may be evenly cooked on all sides.

story.zh: 正方形。五厘米。
story.en: Square shapes. Five centimeters.

story.zh: 这意味着土豆有毒，必须立刻清除。堂吉诃德，把它们收走。
story.en: That is a sign that the potato is poisonous; it must be disposed of immediately. Don Quixote, confiscate it.

story.zh: 所谓“烧焦”，是指长时间暴露在高温中表面出现一定颜色变化，并产生烟味这种现象。
story.en: “Burnt” refers to the condition in which a food item is discolored beyond a certain degree and produces an acrid smell after prolonged exposure to high heat.

story.zh: 而且这一个连里面都彻底烧焦了。如果长期食用，可能会产生身体不适反应，因此扔掉才是正确做法。
story.en: And this one has burnt to its core. It is only right to discard it as long-term consumption of burnt food can negatively impact the body.

story.zh: 合格了。从斜向切这一点可以看出不错的技巧，给你加分。
story.en: This gets a pass. You are rewarded extra points for the expertise displayed in your aslant strokes.

story.zh: ……我认输。
story.en: …Je m’avoue vaincu.

story.zh: 尽管如此，我对这次对决也毫不后悔。
story.en: Nevertheless, I hold no regrets over this battle.

story.zh: 分析错误，毕竟这个玩偶还有着躯干和四肢。
story.en: That is an incorrect assessment as the doll has a torso and limbs.

story.zh: 附议。
story.en: D'accord.

story.zh: 看来与刚才遭遇的个体为同一物种。
story.en: They appear to be of the same species as the one we encountered earlier.

story.zh: 嗯，不是相似，而是确实属于同一个体。
story.en: Hm, they are not "pretty similar", they are indeed of the same species.

story.zh: 考虑到目前为止的效率，似乎无法进行适当的休息。
story.en: Considering our current productivity rate, it seems that we will not be provided with adequate rest.

story.zh: 减少目前的睡眠时间将更为妥当。
story.en: Perhaps reducing the time dedicated to sleep would be contributive to our collective effort.

story.zh: 我知道规则和规模。可以直接绘制球场。
story.en: I am aware of the rules and the specifications of this game. Allow me to draw the arena.

story.zh: 喝。
story.en: Hm.

story.zh: 不，这里“折·足”更合适。
story.en: No, SILO would be preferable here.

story.zh: ……并非提议给予它们更多痛苦，仅是提出正确烹饪方法。
story.en: My suggestion was not to inflict them further pain. Simply a more appropriate method of engaging in the culinary arts.

story.zh: 已取出。然而其似乎已失去作为食物的功能。
story.en: It has been extracted. However, this can no longer serve its function as a proper source of nutrients.

story.zh: 确切来说是28遍。如果到了第30遍，我便计划检查其枕骨区是否受到损伤。
story.en: She has repeated that phrase twenty-eight times, to be precise. At thirty, I was planning to verify if she had suffered any damages to her occipital region.

story.zh: 郊区地带的危险程度比我们平常进行作战的地点更高。考虑到需要贴身保护执行经理，应当制定更为系统的计划……
story.en: Exploring the Outskirts area will carry higher risks than our usual operation grounds. To ensure the Manager's safety, we must first establish a more structured plan—

story.zh: 我们在抵达这扇门之前，与走廊中的部分实体进行了战斗。
story.en: We engaged several entities of the corridor on our path to this door.

story.zh: 或许我们会成为消失在走廊某处的尸体，永远无法复活。
story.en: We could have been lost forever in some corner of the corridors as bodies, never to be revived nor retrieved.

story.zh: 目前似乎仍然开放着。
story.en: It is open. For now.

story.zh: 假设礼物没有被送出，我知道他们最有可能在哪里。
story.en: I have discovered a location with a high probability of their presence. Presuming that they haven't been turned into gifts yet.

story.zh: 那里，挂着礼物组装处的招牌。
story.en: There. The placard says 'Gift Assembly'.

story.zh: 也可能是都市中某片翼将任务外包给了郊区的工厂。
story.en: There is a possibility that they may be contractors to one of the Wings in the City.

story.zh: 这就像小时候被妈妈训斥时的场景一样。
story.en: My mother used to scold me like this in my youth.

story.zh: 用人类制成玩具，再赠送给那些憎恨人类的存在吗。
story.en: I see. You produce toys out of humans and gift them to those who harbor hatred for humans.

story.zh: 纯粹出于善意。
story.en: Out of the pure goodness of your heart.

story.zh: 是熟悉的声音。这种分贝与堂吉诃德的叫喊声相符。
story.en: I am familiar with this tone. The decibel range of this screaming is an exact match with Don Quixote's.

story.zh: 是指我们途经的港船发行的发廊优惠券吗。
story.en: You are speaking of the portship we sailed past. The portship on which the hair salon that printed those hair coupons conducts their business.

story.zh: 与航路相背，不具备可使用的条件。
story.en: The coupons could not be used, as the portship was not on our charted route.

story.zh: 意为消灭对象吗。
story.en: I believe that he means to say that they must be eliminated.

story.zh: 我明白了。
story.en: I do not.

story.zh: 我同意。并且我们没有名分或指示要在乱战中冒着危害救助那人。
story.en: Agreed. It is no complicated mathematics to expect unnecessary allied casualties in this effort should we involve ourselves in this conflict.

story.zh: 事实上因为不用猜测隐含的意图，也便于我整理思绪。
story.en: I found her manner of speech quite convenient. There was no need to unnecessarily read between the lines. I had little trouble understanding her and organizing my thoughts accordingly.

story.zh: 他的服装与黑云会的人非常相似。这个人有很大可能性和他们有关，更有可能是他们的上级。
story.en: His garb, which highly resembles the Kurokumo Clan's standard outfits, suggests that he is a relevant individual in this case. It is possible to extrapolate from his outfit that he is of higher rank than any foe we have defeated on the course to this location.

story.zh: 他已经进去了。
story.en: He has already entered the dungeon.

story.zh: 大约3分钟前，我看见名为樱桃的人将他拖至沙发后方。
story.en: The individual by the name Aeng-du dragged him behind that sofa. Approximate time of event: three minutes ago.

story.zh: ……如果再发生类似情况我会立刻汇报。
story.en: ... I will make an immediate report should an identical incident occur.
... Hmph!

story.zh: 已按照您的命令执行。
story.en: I have carried out the task as you have ordered.

story.zh: 所谓的媒体一般都是这样。
story.en: This is within the expected range of behavior for the news media.

story.zh: 出现了。
story.en: —appear.

story.zh: 无法理解。执行经理的能力持续时间仅有不到30分钟。4小时为误算的概率很高。
story.en: Impossible. The manager's ability was activated for less than thirty minutes. It is most likely that your four-hour measurement is a calculation error.

story.zh: 发现异象。
story.en: I have identified an anomaly.

story.zh: 考虑到在宅邸度过的时间，提供给我们的应该是晨报，但这一份是晚报。
story.en: We should have been issued the morning newspaper, not the evening newspaper. This is inconsistent with the amount of time we spent at the manor.

story.zh: 这辆巴士有着持续性的报纸供应，并且总是在特定的时间收到晨报与晚报。
story.en: As long as I have been a passenger of this bus, morning papers have always been delivered during designated morning hours, and evening papers have always been delivered during designated evening hours.

story.zh: 虽然有出现失误的可能，但可以认为这种事发生的概率极小。
story.en: The possibility that they have made a mistake cannot be completely ruled out. However, the likelihood of that is minuscule.

story.zh: 嗯。也就是说在宅邸内时间的流逝比外界快。
story.en: Hm. Then, with this information, it can be concluded that the time we have experienced within the manor was flowing at a faster rate than the world outside.

story.zh: 晚报的派发情况也就说得通了。
story.en: That is a coherent explanation as to why the evening newspaper, instead of the morning newspaper, was issued.

story.zh: 我被告知要站在这里，所以就站上来了。
story.en: I was told to stand here, so I have done so.

story.zh: 准备好了。
story.en: I am ready.

story.zh: 嗯。没事。
story.en: Mm. I am all right.
Mm...

story.zh: 没有自愿参加的理由。
story.en: There was no reason to volunteer.

story.zh: 看来这是和我们至今见过的心象镜像迷宫相同的空间。
story.en: A Mirror Dungeon of the Fathoms. It appears to be the same kind as the one we have seen before.

story.zh: 就算如此，你也无法把时间杀人及一系列行为全部正当化。
story.en: Your explanations fail to justify your 'timekilling'.

story.zh: 嗯。从经理和人格之间的对话记录来看，WARP列车的原理确实多少有些低效且怪异。
story.en: Mm. It can be determined from the conversational records between the Manager and the Identities that the mechanisms behind WARP trains' operations can be deemed as somewhat bizarre and inefficient.

story.zh: 要我乘我便乘。
story.en: I will board the train if I must.

story.zh: 所有WARP列车站台都以其造型与所在巢的特征相配而闻名，而站台的造型本身也被不少人称赞为都市的著名景点之一。
story.en: Every WARP train station has been built with a general design philosophy that draws from its respective Nest's architectural idiosyncrasies. It can also be said that many critics in relevant fields praise the WARP train stations as one of the many cultural cornerstones of the City.
Mm...

story.zh: 不对。那人的服装并非皮革或金属防具，而是由布料制成的。这种款式不论南北都很常见，但在西部属于很少见的东部服饰……
story.en: Incorrect. Leather-based clothing and metal armor are predominant fashion trends often visible in the outfits of the western population. While that individual's cloth-based style is something ubiquitously observed throughout the population of north and south, they are largely considered to be an eastern fashion trend, rarely seen among western—

story.zh: 那只需要观察一下眼前之人就能明白。
story.en: An opportunity for a firsthand observation stands before you.

story.zh: 如果打开门，在数秒内躯体就会支离破碎。
story.en: Opening the door will result in near-immediate destruction of the physical body.

story.zh: 他们的攻击模式并非基于理性思考。可以解释为他们将攻击本能向我们发泄。
story.en: It could be determined from the entities' behavior that their attack patterns have no basis in rational thought. The source of this behavior can only be traced back to primal aggressiveness.

story.zh: 这一推测并无漏洞。
story.en: There is no incongruence in that logic.

story.zh: 即使同为生物型义手，像这般无骨骼的旧式型号最近在都市也十分罕见，因此会产生混淆也是正常的。
story.en: It is possible that you are mistaken due to his bio-prosthetic being of an older, outdated make that is now rarely seen in the City.

story.zh: 可以看到四处散落着带有血块的义体部件以及碎片，能确认这里就是大多数义体收尾人搭乘的车厢。
story.en: The various destroyed prosthetic parts covered in human remains indicate that this train car was boarded by several prosthetic-equipped Fixers.

story.zh: 根据站台上的宣传册，这辆列车由十二节客运车厢和一节货运车厢组成。
story.en: As per the information provided by the pamphlet at the platform, it is likely that this train is composed of twelve passenger cars and one freight car.

story.zh: 现在到达的是第十一节车厢。除去梅菲斯托费勒斯所在的第十三节车厢，还剩下一节。
story.en: Because we are on the eleventh car at the moment, that leaves a single car between us and the freight car in which Mephistopheles is secured.

story.zh: 我们很有可能会直面制造这些血袋的血魔。
story.en: Which means that there is a high likelihood that we will soon encounter the Bloodfiend responsible for the creation of the Bloodbags aboard this train.

story.zh: 反过来说，正因为它能率领如此多的血袋，将其视为高危的存在比较合理。
story.en: A different, more accurate interpretation would be to say that a being capable of commanding a force as large as the Bloodbags we have defeated should be considered a high-risk entity.

story.zh: 由于与血魔的不断战斗，大多数人员都处于失去意识的状态。
story.en: Most had lost their consciousness from the mental stress of the prolonged battle against the Bloodfiend.

story.zh: 经理的处理措施是适当的。
story.en: Therefore, whatever measure it was that the Manager has taken, it was appropriate.

story.zh: 然而。
story.en: However.

story.zh: 此处对于“大多数人员”的定义为除3人以外的人员，因此如需说明，最好对该部分人员进行询问。
story.en: The definition of "most" excludes three individuals. Thus, it would be most appropriate to direct any questions to them.

story.zh: 浮士德。
story.en: Faust.

story.zh: 经理。
story.en: The Manager.

story.zh: 以及还没有清醒过来的堂吉诃德。
story.en: And Don Quixote, who is still unconscious.
