story.zh: 在失去意识之前，我通过听到的脚步声和声音分析出来的。
story.en: I have identified the three conscious individuals by analyzing their walking cadence and voices, moments before my loss of consciousness.

story.zh: 已经成了半液体的状态。和他的指骨混在了一起。好像是中指的指骨。
story.en: It has been half liquefied. The remains have melded with his finger bones; it appears to have become one with the middle phalanges.

story.zh: 就是这个地方。但进入舱内的人却不见了，这说明……
story.en: This is the correct spot. Then the disappearance of the individual who has entered this pod would indicate...

story.zh: 综合上下文，他似乎想说“休假”一词。
story.en: Contextual clues suggest that he is making a request for a vacation.

story.zh: 我熟知人体各处的主要肌肉与神经的所在位置。
story.en: I have an astute knowledge of the major muscle groups and nerve structures of the human body.

story.zh: 报纸也经常刊登专栏，密集报道W公司的财务危机。重点聚焦于神秘失踪事件。
story.en: Newspapers also featured Op-Eds regarding a possible management crisis at W Corp., with many of them discussing the mysterious disappearances as well.

story.zh: 果断、重视目标。
story.en: Strong, decisive, and goal-oriented.

story.zh: 若有需要，我随时准备提供必要的援助。
story.en: I am always prepared to administer necessary aid, should you request it.

story.zh: 虽然捕捉到了部分相似之处，但似乎并非完全相同的存在。
story.en: While there are partial similarities to their gears, enough differences are present to distinguish them.

story.zh: 每天规律且重复的生活是高效的。
story.en: It is efficient to live within the bounds of rigidly established routines.

story.zh: 嗯。
story.en: Mm.

story.zh: 先行冲进去是危险的。但，已经走了啊。
story.en: Charging alone into danger poses— Too late.

story.zh: 嗯。正确的评估。
story.en: Mm. A correct assessment.

story.zh: 遵从您的命令。
story.en: It will be done as you commanded.

story.zh: 脑叶公司。5分钟。可能性。期待。右臂。
story.en: Lobotomy Corporation. Five Minutes. Potentiality. Anticipation. Right-hand.

story.zh: 所指的应该是丸药，以药材制成的丸状药物。
story.en: She is likely referring to medicines brewed and kneaded into ball-shaped pills.

story.zh: 嗯。如果采用大量不同体系的手术方法，各方法之间产生冲突的概率也必然会增长。
story.en: Mm. It is highly likely that inter-operation conflicts or issues will arise when applying highly disparate treatment methods to a single body.

story.zh: 这段发言使人意识到普及六何分析法的重要性与必要性。
story.en: The briefing was a good demonstration of the necessity of educating the 'Five Ws and One H' principle.

story.zh: 那些冲上来的人似乎都已被消灭了。
story.en: Hostiles in the immediate vicinity have been eliminated.

story.zh: 可以。
story.en: It will be done.

story.zh: 嗯。需要让他们无法向外界透露我们在此处的信息。
story.en: Mm. They must not be allowed to disseminate our current location.

story.zh: 我明白了。
story.en: It will be done.

story.zh: 嗯。每走一步靴子上都会沾上黑色的物质。
story.en: Mm. Every step on the floor leaves black residue on the shoes.

story.zh: 经理，其他罪人正在陆续集结。
story.en: The other Sinners are starting to gather, manager.

story.zh: 根据墙壁溶解的形态来看，似乎是以相同的方式入侵了全部罪人。
story.en: Extrapolating from the pattern by which the walls have disintegrated, it is likely that they utilized the identical means of infiltration for each Sinner.

story.zh: 只能坚持下去了。
story.en: There is no choice but to withstand it.

story.zh: 她身上名为自信的特性相较于以前有明显下降。
story.en: Her self-confidence has significantly decreased compared to the observation from our previous interaction.

story.zh: 嗯。根据此计划表规定，每日可支配睡眠时间为-3小时。需要T公司协助执行。
story.en: Hm. According to this schedule you have prepared, the student would have negative three hours available for sleep. This lesson plan's execution will require cooperation from T Corp.

story.zh: 罗季昂推荐我根据自己的长处来制定计划。
story.en: This lesson plan was designed based on Rodion’s advice that I must prioritize strengths that are unique to myself.

story.zh: 嗯。
story.en: Hm.

story.zh: 天花板缝隙之间有爬行的声音。
story.en: There are slithering noises coming from above.

story.zh: 只要能够尽礼，细微的手势动作并不重要。
story.en: Expressing respect is the primary purpose. Hand placement and gesture are unimportant if that objective can be accomplished.

story.zh: 嗯。右侧，第三根柱子下面……
story.en: Mm. Beneath the third pillar to the right...

story.zh: 我仔细阅读过相关地区过去5年内的报纸，但并没有发现与此相关的名字。执行经理。
story.en: I have thoroughly reviewed the past 5 years' worth of local newspapers pertaining to the matter, yet no such name relevant to the case was identified, Manager.

story.zh: 准确来说，该假说认为印记的基础运作原理有可能与奇点或遗物相同。
story.en: The precise position of the hypothesis was that the fundamental principles of the Sign's working may be equivalent to those of Singularities or Relics.

story.zh: 不过，从辛克莱身上并未获取任何关键线索，因此目前完全无法验证该假说。
story.en: But as no actionable evidence was obtained from Sinclair, there is presently no means by which this hypothesis may be validated.

story.zh: 若经理下令，我便会遵从。
story.en: I will follow if that is your order, Manager.

story.zh: 执行经理，请来这边。
story.en: This way, Manager.

story.zh: 嗯。刚才在落地时击中的扭曲是最后一个，建筑外的敌人已经全部清理完毕。
story.en: Mm. The force of your landing neutralized the last of the Distortions outside of the building.

story.zh: ……不，这并不是阳光。
story.en: ... No, this is not sunlight.

story.en: Strike a nearby table twice with the guilty one's head. Grab by the hair if possible.

story.zh: 完成。
story.en: Completed.

story.zh: 同时，其辱骂的内容对幼兄来说相当敏感一罪。
story.en: Compounded, in that the said foul language... was about something the Big Brother was particularly sensitive of.

story.zh: 使幼兄不适地叹了两次气一罪。
story.en: The sin of making the Big Brother sigh twice. Uncomfortably.

story.zh: ……囊括起来，唯有以命相抵才算复仇结束。
story.en: ... Only by your death shall this Vengeance be fulfilled.

story.zh: 接下来的流程想必你心知肚明，因此我不再多说。
story.en: I am certain that you are already aware of the following procedures. I will not elaborate further.

story.zh: 你需带着对侮辱中指一事的后悔之情而死。
story.en: Let regret be your last thought. You should not have insulted the Middle.

story.zh: 是的。
story.en: Yes.

story.zh: 我只是进行了观察。
story.en: I have observed. It is nothing of note.

story.zh: 那是我的荣幸。
story.en: In that case, I would be most overjoyed.

story.zh: 我落子了。
story.en: I have made my move.

story.zh: 没关系。这次对局并不计时。
story.en: It is quite all right. We have not set a time limit for this game.

story.zh: 不必在意。作为此场棋局受教之人，我不会因此而催促您。
story.en: Mind me not, Left State Councilor. I am but a student in this match. It would be unbecoming of me to bid you hurry.

story.zh: 是的。
story.en: Yes.

story.zh: 自我成为左议政大人的护卫武士起，已经过去7年又4个月了。
story.en: I have been your protector for seven years and four months, Left State Councilor. Time passes fast.

story.zh: 大人要走的是一条幽暗而艰难的路。
story.en: The path you walk is a dark and arduous one.

story.zh: 但我认为，为了这座巢以及巢中的羽，您一定能做出坚决的判断。
story.en: But I believe that you walk that path with unyielding tenacity for the good of this Nest and its feathers.

story.zh: 十分抱歉。我的回答没能让您满意。
story.en: I apologize. My response must not have been to your satisfaction.

story.zh: 将我这把剑收入囊中的是左议政大人。
story.en: I am your blade to wield, Left State Councilor. You were the one who chose me.

story.zh: 那么，如何处置这把剑全将听凭左议政大人的意愿。
story.en: A blade follows the hand that wields it. And you are that hand, Left State Councilor.

story.zh: 我认为并不需要犹豫。
story.en: I saw no reason for hesitation.

story.zh: 请您下令。
story.en: I will do as you command.

story.zh: 我不理解您为什么将理所当然的事情称作请求。
story.en: I fail to see your purpose in asking me to do the duties that I am already intent on performing.

story.zh: ……明白了，在那之后您要罢免我吗。
story.en: ... Ah, do you seek to dismiss me after this?

story.zh: 遵命。
story.en: It shall be done.

story.zh: 果然是你。
story.en: It was you.

story.zh: 我不会斩下去。因为那不会带来任何改变。
story.en: I will not cut you down. Your death will change nothing.

story.zh: 这只是警告。
story.en: Let this be a warning still.

story.zh: 这是在警告你们，如果某日遇见能将这腐败根茎连根拔起的人，我将回归此地。
story.en: A warning that, if I ever find anyone who is capable of tearing these putrid roots from the ground... I will return.

story.zh: 也是在警告，斩下你的首级是多么轻而易举。
story.en: A warning that I can easily separate your pathetic head from your body as a blade cuts through weed.

story.zh: ……这并非难以回答的问题。
story.en: ... That is a rather straightforward question.

story.zh: 与情报不同，获取知识需要伴随着认知与理解的过程。将所获取的情报通过自身的多种观点亲身咀嚼回味后，才会成为知识。
story.en: Unlike 'information', the accumulation of 'knowledge' involves two extra steps: perception and understanding. One must apply various perspectives to what information was gained, make it their own, and only then does it become knowledge.

story.zh: 这也是一种观点。并不错。只是有其他原因存在。
story.en: Hm. That is certainly one of many perspectives from which to view our practice. It is most likely not incorrect, if incomplete.

story.zh: 晚自习同时也是补习。完成委托后，可以在这段时间内重新积累挥发掉的知识。
story.en: These late-night study sessions double as catch-up sessions. They are the best time to replenish knowledge lost during a contract.

story.zh: 复习已挥发的知识，又在复习的过程中习得新的知识。这就是Dieci协会的晚自习。
story.en: New knowledge can be gained in the process of relearning what was lost; that is the core of the Dieci Association's late-night study sessions.

story.zh: ……虽然仍有不足，但也达成了预期效果。
story.en: We are making... the intended progress, despite certain shortcomings.

story.zh: 我只是按照收留了自己的Dieci协会的期望来完成委托。
story.en: I merely carry out the will of those who have taken me under their wings.

story.zh: 但如果还是想问我的想法……嗯。我应该能够基于现有情报给出答复。
story.en: If you would like to hear my reply still... Mm, I should be able to formulate a sufficient reply based on available information.

story.zh: 遗物的使用方式和原理较为特殊，必定需要分析与探究。而在这一过程中可以得到高质量的知识……
story.en: Each Relic has its idiosyncrasies in usage and mechanisms; naturally, using them requires deep study and analysis. That is the process during which we gain an abundance of first-rate knowledge, and...

story.zh: 同时还能亲身体验废墟的奇异环境。我认为这是最好的学习场所之一。
story.en: ... even have first-hand experience of the unique atmosphere of the Ruins. I judge them to be one of the foremost sites of education.

story.zh: 目标是谒见圣者大人。
story.en: My goal is to be granted audience with the Saint.

story.zh: 西部，东部，北部，南部。Dieci协会在每个地区都有一位圣者。他们都是拥有无数知识的智者。
story.en: In each cardinal branch of the Dieci Association is a Saint. They are wise people, all individuals of unfathomably grand repositories of knowledge.

story.zh: 嗯。准确来说，是现在的我还无法见面。
story.en: Mm. It would be accurate to state that I, at this moment, cannot meet them.

story.zh: 我必须不懈地精进学业……积攒更多的知识。
story.en: I must continue to persevere in my studies and grow my repository of knowledge.

story.zh: 似乎有人入侵了，目的是圣物。
story.en: It appears that someone has broken into this establishment in search of our Holy Relic.

story.zh: 最近多了一个觊觎圣物的帮派。一定是他们做的吧。
story.en: Another new Syndicate covets our Holy Relic. I assume this invasion is their doing.

story.zh: 他们都戴着特征鲜明的红色面罩，幸好不难发现。
story.en: They wear red masks emblematic of their organization; it should not be very difficult to identify them.

story.zh: 不用担心。因为我探求了许多知识。
story.en: There is no need to worry. I have been rather studious as of late.

story.zh: 把圣物的祝福误认为圣物。你盲从了错误的情报。
story.en: You mistook the Holy Relic's blessing for the Relic itself, allowing misinformation to guide your path.

story.zh: 他选择面对我，那我就再一次用这拳头让他有所领悟。
story.en: I have beaten wisdom into this foe, for it has chosen to face me.

story.zh: 关于此问题，在Cinq协会官方宣传手册第35页中有详细解答。
story.en: A detailed answer to that question can be found on page thirty-five of Cinq Association's official promotion booklet.

story.zh: 虽然我可以直接告知您其中的内容，但由于您牺牲了宝贵时间前来采访，因此还是推荐您询问无法通过外部方式获取的信息。
story.en: While I can verbally relay that information to you, consider that you are making use of your own precious time to conduct this interview; it is recommended that you ask questions that cannot be answered by external means.

story.zh: 嗯。事实如此。
story.en: That is a true statement, yes.

story.zh: 还是推荐您观看直播回放。我看过最近重新剪辑我的直播画面的视频，其中加入的夸张成分和华丽效果导致无法确认最重要的招式——
story.en: Ah, it would be preferable to rewatch the recording of my broadcasts instead of the 'edits'. I have watched several stream compilations of my broadcasts and determined that the various visual effects and exaggerated edits make it difficult to observe the form and the movement, both of which are of paramount importance—

story.zh: 嗯，这个问题我已在直播进行了多次回答……
story.en: Mm. That is a question that has been answered numerous times during my broadc—

story.zh: ……我明白了。是我考虑不周，实在抱歉。
story.en: ... I see, I did not think of that. My apologies.

story.zh: 起初，我需要能准确评判自己招式的匿名者。
story.en: It began with the need for anonymous critiques of my form.

story.zh: 虽然不知是出于什么原因……但协会内的同事似乎没有对我进行严厉批判的意愿。
story.en: For reasons that I am unaware of... my colleagues within the Association seemed unwilling to make honest criticisms for me.

story.zh: 不出所料，匿名批判对我的个人发展十分有用。至于其附带的效果……
story.en: As expected, critiques from anonymous sources have been very beneficial to the improvement of my skills. Incidental benefits of this practice were—

story.zh: 嗯，正好。
story.en: ... Mm. This is quite the timely opportunity.

story.zh: 嗯。我之前在直播中提到自己要去北部出差的消息，于是收到了很多决斗申请。
story.en: Mm. I mentioned in passing in one of my broadcasts that I am going on an expedition in the northern regions. Thereafter, I received several, simultaneous challenges to a duel.

story.zh: 因为一次性前来更有效率，因此我与他们约好了时间，但没想到这场采访会持续到现在。
story.en: I made an appointment with all of them, scheduled to occur at the same time, for the sake of efficiency. However, it seems that I have underestimated the duration of this interview.

story.zh: 我建议您暂时停止录像。这次我会开启个人直播，如需确认，可以观看那边的影像。
story.en: It may be wise to stop the recording for a moment. If you would like to analyze my form, then I refer you to my currently live broadcast.

story.zh: 如您所说，考虑到大多观众，场面或许会有些残酷。
story.en: The following scene may be too violent for a majority of your viewers, as you have stated earlier.

story.zh: 据确认，Öufi协会的公证已经通过。
story.en: I believe that the Öufi Association has already notarized this activity.

story.zh: 明智的判断。那么。
story.en: Very wise. Well, then.

story.zh: 初次观看的人或许会很难跟上动作。但回放支持慢速播放……
story.en: It may be difficult for first-time viewers to follow my movement. Viewers who would prefer to review the video may re-watch this stream at a slower speed—

story.zh: ……如你所见，虽然房间有点乱，但还是请坐下吧。
story.en: ... I understand that the room may be disorderly. But I insist that you sit anyway.

story.zh: 我希望你能理解这里的杂乱。对于拇指而言，礼仪教育是相当重要的。
story.en: I trust you would find the present state of my office acceptable. The Thumb treats lessons in manners with utmost seriousness.

story.zh: 虽然我本就不认为会提出想与我单独见面的能是什么普通人物。
story.en: I did expect someone of higher station given the private one-to-one meeting request, but...

story.zh: 请允许我对您致以敬意。您的阶级值得如此。
story.en: ... Allow me to treat you with better manners. It seems that your station deserves as much.

story.zh: 我为此前粗俗的语气表示歉意。如果惹您不快，我会依照您的意愿，根据拇指的礼仪处置自己的身体。
story.en: Apologies for my earlier effrontery, my lady. I am willing to self-mutilate according to The Thumb's rules of respect as much as you would like.

story.zh: 您不拘于阶级，体恤他人的言行令我印象深刻。您值得被致以敬意。
story.en:
I am highly impressed by your lack of concern for the rigidity of hierarchy, and your considerate behavior befitting your nobility.
You are someone deserving of proper respect indeed.

story.zh: ……恕我失礼，但既然这里是我的办公室，那么应该算是合乎情理。
story.en: ... While it may be discourteous, this is, after all, my office; I do not believe that my subsequent request would go against reason.

story.zh: 请问我可以抽一根雪茄吗。
story.en: May I have your permission to light a cigar?

story.zh: 那么，感谢您的理解。
story.en: Thank you. I appreciate your understanding, my lady.

story.zh: 请允许我总结一下您的陈述，即……您希望我在即将于鸿园举办的“家主之争”中，作为史家的势力大展身手。
story.en: So... to summarize your offer, you would like for me to serve the role of a clan member in this 'Family Hierarch war' of Hongyuan on the side of the Shi family.

story.zh: 除此以外……如果被选出的家主不是史家之人……就斩下那位家主的头，令鸿园陷入混乱……是吗。
story.en: And, if... the next Hierarch is not one from the Shi family, decapitate the Hierarch-to-be, and plummet Hongyuan into... chaos.

story.zh: 您一定比我清楚，这样的事件不会作为单纯的家族间政争而收尾。
story.en: I am certain that my lady is discerning enough to understand that the ramifications of such an incident will inevitably spread beyond the political conflict between the families.

story.zh: 您似乎想让我们成为预示翼际战争开始的狼烟。不是吗。
story.en: Your request is that we are to become the blast of firepower signaling the start to a Wing War. Please illuminate me if my assessment is incorrect.
... Puff.

story.zh: 即使阶级在我之上，也不代表您可以口无遮拦。
story.en: Your higher placement on the hierarchy does not grant you the right to say to my face whatever comes to your mind.

story.zh: 拇指无所不能。您刚刚的发言可以被理解为对帮派本身的侮辱。
story.en: There is no such thing as 'too much' for The Thumb. Your statement has room to be interpreted as an expression of disrespect to the Syndicate itself.

story.zh: 那即为对二老板的侮辱。依照我们的纪律，即刻对您进行惩罚也没有任何问题。
story.en: And to do so would be to disrespect the esteemed underboss—meaning, to punish you would not go against the tenets of our organization.

story.zh: 我给予您证明我理解有误的机会。
story.en: I will now present before you an opportunity to claim that my interpretation was but a misunderstanding.

story.zh: 那么，我将以字面意义理解您的回答。
story.en: Very well. Then I will understand your proposition in a more literal manner.

story.zh: 不过这么一来……便需要进行相应的“准备”。
story.en: Then... please, allow me to inquire about your... 'preparation' for the task at hand.

story.zh: 这些被称为虎标弹。虽然都市的子弹价格本就高昂，但这些的价格要更上一层。
story.en: We call them Tigermark Rounds(虎標彈). The City makes it rather difficult to make liberal use of ammunition, but these are quite special, even among them.

story.zh: 而我的部下们所用的推进弹的价格，每一发也都不可小觑。
story.en: Not to mention the cost for my subordinates' propellant ammo.

story.zh: 我想问您，能让“我”在那里大施拳脚的价钱，您是否已准备好了？
story.en: In addition, I must also ask if you really are prepared to pay the price of letting me loose.

story.zh: 恕我有言在先……我是一旦动手就不会吝惜子弹的类型，望您参考。
story.en: Be assured, however, that... once we are committed to a mission, we do make liberal use of ammunition. Take this into your consideration.

story.zh: 我并不为此感到担心。
story.en: That is not the concern that I am speaking of.

story.zh: 我所问的是，并非史家之人的您，能否周转如此庞大的资金。
story.en: My concern is about how you, someone who's not even from the Shi family, can mobilize such a significant amount of capital.

story.zh: 指挥官一职可并非只是坐享其成便能得到。
story.en: It takes more than sitting around to earn the title of a Capo.

story.zh: ……我们会接受委托。
story.en: ... We will take the contract.

story.zh: 她知道天退星刀的来历。
story.en: She knows the origin of the Tiantui Star's blade.

story.zh: 那么……她也是小指吗。
story.en: Then... is she also a Pinky?

story.zh: 不，既然是那种阶级的人物……也许是难得一见的，对小指略知一二之人。
story.en: No. It is possible that someone of her station could have heard hints or vague tales about the Pinky.

story.zh: ……那不重要。
story.en: ... It doesn't matter.

story.zh: 既然相隔这么近，那么烙印升温时自然会见到。
story.en: If someone is this close by, I suppose I shall encounter them when the stigma burns hot.

story.zh: 如果是召集小指，那么只能叫来附近地区的人。
story.en: The Pinky cannot help but summon only those who are nearby.

story.zh: 而且这对拇指而言也不是坏事……且相当合理。
story.en: Besides, this is good work for The Thumb, and... reasonable.

story.zh: 更何况……
story.en: More than anything, however...

story.zh: 我感觉，自己能少见地乐在其中。
story.en: ... I think this will be fun. What a rare sense of anticipation.

story.zh: 消耗了18枚虎标弹……
story.en: 18 Tigermark rounds spent...

story.zh: 你们是叫贾蓝队吧。
story.en: The Jialan Guards(賈藍隊)...

story.zh: 虽说担任了守护名门贾家这一重任……却不算什么难题啊。
story.en: So much for the protectors of the noble Jia family... They made for quite the disappointing task.

story.zh: ……既然你们无法提供娱乐，那我只能将挥刀本身作为乐趣了。
story.en: ... If this is all the fun they have to offer, I suppose I must find entertainment in the freedom of getting to swing this blade with abandon.

story.zh: 虽然雇主支付了相当可观的金额，但与之相应的对手实力太过不足……是对手价值估算有误吗。
story.en: For the sum that the client brought, the foes I have faced thus far have been so... tasteless. Perhaps she miscalculated.

story.zh: 如果不是……
story.en: If she did not, then—

story.zh: 啊……来得真晚。
story.en: Ah... they were running late.

story.zh: 我正感到无聊……想稍微消遣一番呢。
story.en: The ennui drove me to... relish this dance, for but a moment.

story.zh: 公主，你有什么话要说。
story.en: Have you aught to say, Princess?

story.zh: 你是在劝我逃跑吗，公主。
story.en: Are you suggesting that I flee, Princess?

story.zh: 作为一国王子，理应与王国的敌人战斗到最后才是……
story.en: A royal prince must rightly stand his ground, no matter what is to come. He shall fight to the bitter end...

story.zh: 因为这是永无止境的，充满祝福的嘉年华。
story.en: Indeed. For this is the endlessly, eternally blessed Carnival.

story.zh: ……你的意思是。
story.en: ... You mean...?

story.zh: ……如果这就是王国中最睿智又最美丽的公主的旨意。
story.en: ... If that is your will, Princess, the fairest and the wisest of the kingdom, then...

story.zh: 进展如何。
story.en: Report.

story.zh: 嗯。
story.en: Mm.

story.zh: 血袋增加了多少？
story.en: How many new Bloodbags have we gained?

story.zh: 是吗。你的努力值得夸奖。
story.en: Well done. I commend your efforts.

story.zh: 无需恐惧。
story.en: You need not be afraid.

story.zh: 我也曾身为人类。
story.en: For I too, was once human.

story.zh: 嗯。按照都市规定的基准，现在也应该是人类。那么就从将我划分为具有血魔的特殊性之前与之后来看。
story.en: Hm. However, considering the City's standards of what constitutes a human and what does not, I still belong in the former category. Therefore, upon adjusting the distinction to "before Bloodfiend characteristics became apparent" and "after"...

story.zh: 对我而言……不论是身为人类的时期，还是作为王子的时期……
story.en: But to me, the human existence and the princely existence...

story.zh: 都并不能令我感到有什么不同。
story.en: ... were indistinguishable from one another.

story.zh: 对汝……亦是如此。
story.en: Thus, the same shall be true to thee.

story.zh: 已经是第四位受害者了么。
story.en: Victim #4 already.

story.zh: 我警告过工作过程中生物危害可能波及到收容单元之外，因此严禁人员经过这附近。
story.en: I had dispatched a clear warning to all relevant personnel that they must steer clear of the Abnormality's containment unit while Work is in progress, as the biohazardous material the entity secretes could permeate through the barrier.

story.zh: ……物理意义上封锁特定区域是主管的专属权限，因此只能说无可奈何啊。
story.en: ... Perhaps it could not be helped, as the authority to physically quarantine a section of the facility lies with the manager.

story.zh: 其第27次抱怨颈部附近皮肤出现瘙痒感。
story.en: The subject complained of the pruritus of her nape for the 27th time.

story.zh: 为了缓解瘙痒感而抓挠皮肤并没有问题。
story.en: Scratching your skin to address the itchiness will not be a problem.

story.zh: 无需担心摩擦导致的皮肤损伤或出血。
story.en: There is no need for you to worry about the bleeding or excoriation of your skin.

story.zh: 文职人员琥珀，是你吧？
story.en: "Amber" of the Clerical staff. That is you, correct?

story.zh: 访谈开始后，其第28次抱怨瘙痒感。对主要信息的记忆能力良好。
story.en: The subject complained of pruritus for the 28th time since the beginning of this interview. Primary memory retention ability remains in good condition.

story.zh: 至此，已经收集到十名以上的受害者在吸入孢子并经过23小时06分钟21秒后脑部活动不受影响的信息。
story.en: With that, I record that 10 or more casualties have shown no changes to the brain activity at the 23 hours, 06 minutes, and 21 seconds mark since spore inhalation.

story.zh: 因此可得出的结论为，吸入孢子后晚期……推断为“最终孵化”的枕叶肥大症状会在某特定的未知时间点迅速恶化，这使得对于早期探查并去除“卵”这一方案的研究价值提升了7.1409%。
story.en: Extrapolation: Occipital lobe hypertrophy, observed in the late stages of spore infection—henceforth the "pre-hatch" state—accelerates rapidly at an undetermined time since initial contact. This finding boosts the value of "early egg identification & extermination" protocol research by 7.1409%.

story.zh: 你无需理解。
story.en: Nothing that requires your comprehension.

story.zh: 确认到听力丧失。这是至今为止的受害者数据中第一次收集到的情况。
story.en: Loss of hearing identified. This is the first recorded instance of such a symptom among the casualties.

story.zh: 稍等，我需要使用生物扫描仪。
story.en: Hold still. I will use a bioscanner on your abdomen.

story.zh: 不能。把双手从腹部移开。
story.en: It will not. Remove your hands from your abdomen.

story.zh: 经过23小时07分钟01秒，确认到幼虫活动。与现有数据的标准分布相比，其活动约提前了33%。
story.en: Larva activity observed at the 23 hours, 07 minutes, and 01 seconds mark since spore inhalation. This instance has occurred 33% earlier compared to the average extrapolated from the preexisting data's standard normal distribution.

story.zh: 同时可确认到枕叶附近传来的细微震动，由震动向耳部方向移动可推测，其与听力丧失相关的可能性极高。
story.en: Slight palpitations of the occipital lobe area have been observed concurrently. The palpitation is currently traveling to the subject's auditory organ, which leads one to conjecture that it is related to the victim's hearing loss.

story.zh: 自第2龄期变态至第3龄期的速度与现有数据在误差范围内吻合。
story.en: The interval of its molting process from instar 2 to instar 3 remains the same within the margin of error.

story.zh: ……你询问的是哪一方面的“好”？
story.en: ... "Okay" in what sense?

story.zh: 确认到痛觉神经阻断。对受害者……将以笔记形式继续访谈。
story.en: Nullification of pain receptors identified. I will now post any subsequent questions in writing.

story.zh: ……我画下一个勾表示肯定。
story.en: ... I drew an "X" on paper to relay to the victim that Jacob was indeed not sick.

story.zh: 确认到临近最终孵化的症状。准备交战。
story.en: Immediate pre-eclosion symptoms identified. Preparing for battle.

story.zh: 即将孵化。
story.en: It's hatching.

story.zh: ……T-04-50-2的孵化确认与排除同时完成。
story.en: … Eclosion of entity T-04-50-2 identified and eliminated.

story.zh: 并且确认到同一时刻出现琥珀色的考验。
story.en: And the subsequent emergence of Amber Ordeal, also identified.

story.zh: ……排除。
story.en: ... Eliminated.

story.zh: 汇报在T-04-50收容单元附近进行的访谈结果。虽然地点较近，但其进入晚期的时间与平均值差异较小，而认知“女王”的速度相对较快。
story.en: Reporting test results of conducting an interview near T-04-50's containment unit. While no variance in the interval between contraction and the late stage of infection has been observed, it can be said that the subject perceives the "Queen" at a relatively earlier point.

story.zh: 特殊之处在于，从孵化前一刻借受害者之口进行的发言可推测，其脑部神经系统在短时间内遭到占据。
story.en: Recording an observation of note: the entity spoke through the victim immediately before eclosion, suggesting that it has the capability to seize the victim's nervous system.

story.zh: 以及……
story.en: And...

story.zh: 嗯。
story.en: Mm.

story.zh: 又出逃了吗。
story.en: Another containment breach.

story.zh: 我承认那异想体的管理难度。但总是将镇压交给他人并不合适。
story.en: The difficulty of managing the Abnormality is acknowledged. However, continued shirking and offloading of your suppression responsibility to other employees is inappropriate.

story.zh: 既然你有过担任队长的经验，那应当更加负有责任感才是。
story.en: I believe former Captains should be held to a higher degree of accountability.

story.zh: ……我已经向Chesed先生提出这件事的不合理性，但他似乎没有时间见到主管。
story.en: ... I have shared the absurdity of your weapon assignment with Mister Chesed, but it appears that he has not yet found the time to pay the manager a visit.

story.zh: ……黄昏考验还没有结束，去寻找是否有其他走廊需要支援。
story.en: ... The Dusk Ordeal is still in progress. Search for other hallways to assist.

story.zh: 嗯。
story.en: Mm.

story.zh: ……确认到福利部走廊内，并无异常情况。
story.en: ... Welfare Team hallways are clear.

story.zh: 访谈目标的遗体，嗯。
story.en: As for the interview subject's corpse— Hm.

story.zh: ……将连同受害者雅各布一同进行焚烧处理。
story.en: ... It will be cremated alongside victim Jacob's cadaver.

story.zh: 访谈就此结束。
story.en: Concluding the interview.

story.zh: ……那道视线的意义是什么？
story.en: ... What is the meaning of your gaze?

story.zh: 是对通过你提取的武器杀害了你的工蜂而感到愤怒吗？
story.en: Is it wrath? Because I killed your worker bee with the very weapon extracted from your essence?

story.zh: 又或者……是看到了某种别样的救赎或爱意？
story.en: Or... does it look like just another "redemption" or "love" from where you stand?

story.zh: 我对你视野所见如何感到好奇。
story.en: I am curious. How does it all appear in your eyes?

story.zh: 正如你对我视野所见一无所知一般。
story.en: Does it appear as inscrutable as my gaze is to you?

story.zh: ……我并未设想到这般感性的言论。看来需要再次确认E.G.O侵蚀率。
story.en: ... Didn't expect to get sentimental. I will have to check my Corrosion rate.

story.zh: 但首先，继续进行镇压。
story.en: However, the first order of business is completing the suppression effort.

story.zh: 录音结束。
story.en: End of recording.

story.zh: 咕呜呜……
story.en: Grrr...

story.zh: 虽然难以认同，但有这样的想法并非不合理。
story.en: I cannot agree with that statement, but I understand your sentiment behind it.

story.zh: 周边500米内除了老鼠外没有别的生物。没人偷听，就算有也只要把他们切开就好。
story.en: There are nothing but rats in our 500-Meter radius. No one is here to listen. And if anyone does listen, we'll tear them apart as well.

story.zh: 多亏如此，我不仅得了预计之外的肌肉疼痛，还没能拿到和杀人数相称的额外津贴。真是低效的行动。
story.en: Yes. Which led to unscheduled muscle pain and lack of payment for our extra kills. It was inefficient.

story.zh: 因为我们有自己的个性。正如帮派泛滥一样，哪里都不缺事务所。对企业家而言，以这种方式来脱颖而出的决策是合理的。
story.en: This is our niche. There are as many Offices as there are Syndicates; it is a reasonable choice for a businessman to prioritize a smaller niche in an over-saturated market.

story.zh: 那就提出改善措施。
story.en: Will you propose an alternative, then?

story.zh: 也是合理的构想。
story.en: That is also a reasonable suggestion.

story.zh: 不算是问题。接更多活，吃更多东西即可。
story.en: That is an insignificant problem. Simply take more work, increase your earnings, and consume more calories.

story.zh: 有新的联络，是代表。
story.en: Incoming contact. It's from the Representative.

story.zh: 正确。据说……是要前往名为图书馆的地方。
story.en: Precisely. It appears that our next job is... at some Library.

story.zh: 装甲增压……施行。
story.en: Commencing... suit pressurization.

story.zh: 基于第6条第2项A列，为了执行惩罚，已记录于账簿之上。
story.en: This individual's violation was logged for later punishment in accordance with Title 6, Section 2, Row A.

story.zh: 是。因为情况与条款相符。
story.en: Yes. Because the individual's behavior met the specific conditions required to invoke the aforementioned article.

story.zh: 正在寻找与惹人恼火相关的条目。
story.en: Searching for sections relevant to "narking."

story.zh: ……看来是疯了。
story.en: ... He must be mad.

story.zh: 只处刑一次的话，收支似乎无法对上。然而……
story.en: A single execution may not be a sufficient counterweight that negates the grudge. However...

story.zh: 嗯。已确认有过犯了相似罪行的人被杀死十五次以使其神志不清再进行处刑的案例。
story.en: Mm. There exists precedent for a crime not entirely dissimilar to the one currently being addressed, in which a subject whose life was Insured was killed over a dozen times to be rendered into a state of post-resuscitation mental degradation and punch-drunkenness prior to complete and total extermination.

story.zh: 凌晨3点13分……后巷深宵开始了。
story.en: It is currently 3:13 in the morning. The Night in the Backstreets has begun.

story.zh: 第125条第79项P列东部特别条款。使用武器干净利落地斩首。完成。
story.en: Title 125, Section 79, Row P, east-exclusive clause: clean decapitation of the offending party using a weapon. Resolved.

story.zh: 嗯。了解。
story.en: Mm. Understood.

story.zh: 正确的计算。复仇账簿同步的怨恨中，东部的大哥大姐们指定的5条仇怨都已还清了。
story.en: Precisely calculated. Among the retributions that have been synchronized to our Books of Vengeance, five of them that have been highlighted by our seniors in the east are now complete.

story.zh: 第8条第20项A行6列。对所有相关人员即刻处刑。
story.en: Title 8, Section 20, Row A, Line 6. Complete and total extermination of all involved parties.

story.zh: 嗯。见面后，如果对方表现出无礼的态度，最好额外追加应用一些条款。
story.en: Mm. If certain impudent behaviors are observed after our encounter, it may be possible to apply a few more articles to punish them further.

story.zh: 嗯。虽然其外表上有恐怖的部分，但并无警戒的必要。
story.en: Mm. While their exterior may carry elements that inspire fear in some, there is no cause for alarm.

story.zh: 准确来说，只有浮士德和奥提斯二位被认作恩人。
story.en: To be more precise, by ‘saviors’, they are referring only to Faust and Outis.

story.zh: 他们持械的手开始蓄力了。若不尽早回答，则大概率会进入战斗状态。
story.en: Their fingers are tightening around the grips of their weapons. Prolonged silence will most likely turn this into a hostile encounter.

story.zh: 处处无不令人感到荒谬。
story.en: Absurdity is an omnipresence.

story.zh: 因此，这并不是值得抱怨的事情。
story.en: Therefore, it is not a subject by which one should be aggrieved.

story.zh: 与其抱怨，不如多加经历，习惯现实。
story.en: It would be more correct to experience more and acclimatize oneself to it instead of complaining.

story.zh: 嗯。
story.en: Mm.

story.zh: 从词的用法以及分类上看，最为合适的例子应为血魔。相似的外表，不同的本质，足够的知性。
story.en: By context clues and the manner of word usage, including the means of classification, the closest example in our world would be Bloodfiends. Similar external appearances to humans, different natures, comparable sapience.

story.zh: 嗯。袭击过后肌肉力量正在急剧衰退。
story.en: Mm. My strength has rapidly deteriorated since the ambush.

story.zh: 大门纹丝不动，无法开启。
story.en: The door is firmly secured in place.

story.zh: 说“不能说话”是不准确的表述。执行经理的状态应该被表述为：无法产生包含语言发音在内的有意义的交流声音，但可以重复产生类似钟表的秒针、分针等声音，这样的表述才是正确的。
story.en: It is incorrect to state that the manager cannot ‘talk human’. A more accurate assessment would state that the manager is incapable of accessing sonic means of communication, which includes verbal communication; however, they are able to produce repetition of multiple sounds that may register on a similar scale to the ticking of multiple hands—second hands, minute hands—of a clock.

story.zh: 那……不，太阳不仅仅是温暖的。
story.en: It—no. There is more to the sunshine than its warmth.

story.zh: 很明显并非只有单数个体。但……
story.en: There are indeed multiple entities surrounding our ship. However...

story.zh: 默尔索，请如此称呼我吧。
story.en: Meursault. Please refer to me as such.

story.zh: 不值一提。只是常规态度。
story.en: This isn’t anything special. I’m simply behaving normally.

story.zh: 好的。
story.en: Yes.

story.zh: 这就是目的吧。
story.en: That appears to be the intent.

story.zh: 财富的再分配。
story.en: The redistribution of wealth.

story.zh:
解决方法很简单。不论何种帮派，只要消灭头目，
支撑其的血肉也会分崩离析。
story.en: The solution is simple: Any organization can be brought down by killing its leader. Smash the head in, and the sack of meat propping it up will also collapse.

story.zh: 真是阴沉。
story.en: Sombre.

story.zh: 你是如何知晓的？他分明是全身义体，无法看出表情。
story.en: How did you know that? You couldn’t have read the tells from his mechanical body.

story.zh: 他面色惨白。还伴随着过度呼吸与浑身发冷的症状。
story.en: He’s turned pale. He’s also suffering from hyperventilation and tremors.

story.zh: 从维吉里乌斯先生提到K公司开始。
story.en: Ever since Mister Vergilius mentioned K Corp.

story.zh: ……因为您并没有命令我这么做。
story.en: …Because you did not order me to do so.

story.zh: ……我已经听到有几个不速之客包围了巴士。
story.en: …I hear several interlopers surrounding the bus.

story.zh: 那边的武装警卫人数也是我们这一侧的三倍。
story.en: There are many armed guards as well. Three times as many compared to this side.

story.zh: 无论砍去多少肉都会再生出来。
story.en: The flesh regrows as soon as it’s removed.

story.zh: 很难正常地继续战斗下去。
story.en: It is difficult to continue on with combat.

story.zh: 还剩三秒。执行经理，决断为？
story.en: ETA is three seconds. Manager, your judgement?

story.zh: 钉与锤……将经验视为最为重要的价值的翼。
story.en: Nagel und Hammer… The Wing that values experience above all else.

story.zh: 人类生来便注定具有与其价值相符的经验和行为……他们是这么描述经验的。
story.en: Humans are made to have experiences and actions appropriate for their worth… That is what they say of it.

story.zh: ……附近无人生还。
story.en: …There are no survivors nearby.

story.zh: 钉与锤总是埋头于解析人性。
story.en: Nagel und Hammer has always been devoted to scrutinizing the idea of humanity.

story.zh: 他们中有些人说苦难也是人类理所当然的体验，因此会谴责那些加装了义体的人。不过从未像如今这样付诸实践。
story.en: Some criticized prosthetic use, as they believed that pain is a necessary component of the human experience. However, it never escalated to the extent of direct action that we are witnessing now.

story.zh: ……因为我曾是N公司的员工。
story.en: …I was once employed by N Corp.

story.zh: 虽未一起共事过，但从所属公司的角度来看，确实。
story.en: I have never worked with those specific individuals, but in terms of affiliation, you can say that I did.

story.zh: 有提及的必要吗？
story.en: Am I obligated to elaborate?

story.zh: 曾经有段时间，我确实在思考这个问题。
story.en: There was a time when I thought about such things.

story.zh: 但没有得出相同或相悖的答案。
story.en: Though I did not come to a conclusion.

story.zh: 一定要给出答案吗？这对完成工作毫无帮助。
story.en: Must I give an answer? That does not aid us in handling our work.

story.zh: 员工服从命令本就是规则。维吉里乌斯他所出具的从业规范中已经写明了。
story.en: An employee must follow their employer’s orders. The terms Vergilius presented state as much.

story.zh: 若经理下令去做，我便去做。若需要我提出自己的想法，我便会说，但我并没有在不必要的情况下喋喋不休的习惯。
story.en: If the manager orders me to do such a thing, I will do it. I may provide my input if I am told that it is necessary, but I do not have a habit of rambling my thoughts unprompted.

story.zh: 我由16%的蛋白质、60%的水分、以及7%的无机物构成，此点明确表明了我们之间的不同。
story.en: I am 16% proteins, 60% water, 7% minerals, and so forth; I am clearly different in terms of composition.

story.zh: 此外，我的构成中并不含有多余的重金属。
story.en: Moreover, unnecessary heavy metals do not comprise any portion of my body.

story.zh: 这又是一处不同。
story.en: That is another difference.

story.zh: 40岁左右的男性。后脑部貌似受到了严重的损伤。在撞击之前便已死去。
story.en: A male individual who appears to be in his early 40s. There seems to be a serious injury in his occipital region. He had already died before the impact.

story.zh: 前面的东西，不具有人类的形态吗？
story.en: Did the entity you witnessed have a form that does not resemble a human?

story.zh: 如果要在罪人之间做最佳判断，此人的话确实正确。
story.en: If we must make the best decision between the Sinners, it’s right to listen to her.

story.zh: 如果是决定，那便遵从。
story.en: If that is your decision, I will abide by it.

story.zh: 数量不少。而且这些无人机……
story.en: There is a considerable number of them. And these drones…

story.zh: 似乎是在刻意进行封锁，让人无法接近异想体活动的区域。
story.en: They appear to be deliberately preventing us from entering the area where the Abnormality is.

story.zh: 确实如此。
story.en: That is certainly true.

story.zh: 理所当然。
story.en: Natural behavior.

story.zh: 如果伤口都能在几秒内复原，那么所有判断都将是次要的。
story.en: If all wounds can be healed up in seconds, all judgement regarding it will be secondary.

story.zh: 我不明白你为什么这样思考。
story.en: I don't see a reason to think about such things.

story.zh: 我理解了。这机器运作停止之后便会自动放出录音，然后在数秒之内爆炸。
story.en: I understand now. Once the machines stop functioning, they play a prerecorded voice clip, then explode seconds after.

story.zh: 虽然并不清楚它们的目的是什么，但所有的机器都拥有着相同的机制。
story.en: It is unclear what purpose they are meant to serve, but all the machines are equipped with the same mechanisms.
...Cough.

story.zh: ……我的职责就是保证经理的生命安全并平安完成公司的任务。
story.en: ...It was my directive to protect the manager and see that the company's mission is accomplished.

story.zh: 我同意。
story.en: I agree with it.

story.zh: 毫无疑问，我们之间出了一名叛徒。
story.en: There's a traitor in our ranks. No doubt remains in the matter.

story.zh: 多亏了这个叛徒，我们的路线和计划在出发的时候就已经泄露了。
story.en: It's thanks to this spy that our course and plans were leaked from the moment we departed.

story.zh: 为了止损，我们应当现在就处理掉这个叛徒。
story.en: To prevent further damage, it is right to dispose of them here and now.

story.zh: 还有一件事。
story.en: There is one more thing.

story.zh: 当我们遇到兰的时候……
story.en: When we encountered Ran...

story.zh: 他们提前和她拉开了距离。唯一的解释就是，他们早就知道会有一场爆炸发生。
story.en: They were distancing themselves from her in advance. The only explanation is that they knew there would be an explosion.

story.zh: 我同意该判断。
story.en: I agree with it.

story.zh: 嗯。合同条件已完成。
story.en: Indeed. The contract has been fulfilled.

story.zh: ……是吗。
story.en: …I see.

story.zh: ……只要您指示。
story.en: ...As long as you command.

story.zh: 我回来了。
story.en: I've returned.

story.zh: 施伦妮的邮箱内有一封值得阅读的邮件。
story.en: There was one message in Shrenne's mailbox that was deemed worth reading.

story.zh: 只是当时的环境不适合打印，所以我将其全部记忆了。
story.en: The environment did not permit me to print it out, so I memorized the mail's content.

story.zh: “希望您一切安好，前辈。左括号、星星、泪水、泪水、以及波浪号与脱字符、脱字符……右括号。”
story.en: 'I hope you're doing well, Miss Ran. Open parenthesis, star, tear, tear, swung dash, caret, caret... closed parenthesis.'

story.zh: 明白了。我会省略掉那些不太重要的标点符号。
story.en: Understood. I will then dispense with punctuation marks that do not appear important.

story.zh: “我虽然想查清楚前辈说的是不是真的，但是因为那个该死的家伙，导致我很难接近。”
story.en: 'I've been trying to figure out if what you said was really true, but that sucker is making it hard.'

story.zh: “那我宁可放弃一切繁荣。”
story.en: 'Then I'm willing to give up on all the prosperity it brings'.

story.zh: “望您保重……谨上。”
story.en: 'That's all I have to say for now. Yours in haste...'

story.zh: 星星，爱心爱心爱心。
story.en: Star, star, heart heart heart.

story.zh: 由于这些符号可能是某种序列或者密码，比起排除其可能是必要情报的可能性，由经理来给出判断更为合理。因此我并没有进行是否应该将其省略的判断，而只是将其罗列在这里。
story.en: There's a possibility that it may have been a sequence or cipher, so I deemed it reasonable to read it out and let the manager determine its significance rather than mull over whether I should dispense with it and discount the possibility that it may be necessary information.

story.zh: 物色人才或在企业间跳槽都是根据利益和效率而进行的。
story.en: Headhunting and changing jobs between firms are done based on interests and efficiency.

story.zh: 这就是交易的结果。
story.en: This is what the deal entailed.

story.zh: 不同，而且有问题。
story.en: It's different, and wrong.

story.zh: 与我们不同，他们的复原并不完全。他们只是……
story.en: Theirs is not a complete restoration, unlike our case. They're merely...

story.zh: 只是能够行动的状态而已。看起来并没有任何意识和理性存在。
story.en: Animated. That is all. They appear to lack consciousness and reason.

story.zh: 那么，合理推测演员是按角色数量分配的。
story.en: It's then reasonable to assume that each actor in the play was provided with one.

story.zh: 正如大家所希望的那样……我们可以在这里将研究继续下去。
story.en: As everyone wished... We were free to continue our research here.

story.zh: 因为其中的颜色需要归还，所以看不到其闪耀。
story.en: Even though we had to yield the colors in them, making it so they didn't outwardly shine.

story.zh: 是虚假因果谬误。
story.en: False Cause Fallacy.

story.zh: 若要离开此区域，沿直线距离航行大约还剩15km。
story.en: We are approximately 15km away from the edge of this zone as the crow flies.

story.zh: 需要人均承担时速10km以上的推进力才能安全通过。
story.en: Each person must pedal to generate enough energy to travel at least 10km per hour if we are to escape in time.

story.zh: 呼。呼。呼。呼。
story.en: Hup. Hup. Hup. Hup.

story.zh: 对于这种强度的脚踏运动，腹式呼吸最为有效。
story.en: Diaphragmatic breathing is conducive to maintaining consistent speed in an exercise of this intensity.

story.zh: 节省语句，调整呼吸。否则节奏会被打乱。吸气，呼气，吸气，呼气，吸气，呼气，吸气，呼气，吸气，呼气……
story.en: Save your words. Your breathing. Remain. In the flow. Breathe in. Out. Breathe in. Out. Breathe in. Out. Breathe in. Out. Breathe in. Out.

story.zh: 如果我们再遭到同样的攻击，就没有胜算了。
story.en: We have no chance of weathering a single strike from one of its limbs.

story.zh: 他们似乎在我们到来前以入睡来消磨时间。
story.en: It appears that they have elected to sleep in lieu of our appearance.

story.zh: 如果发生这种情况，我们的胜算微乎其微。对没有足够多关于U公司的情报的我们来说，会陷入相当不利的状况。
story.en: Our chance of victory is slim, should such an event come to pass. We do not possess enough intel on U Corp. to effectively maneuver that situation.

story.zh: 对经理决定的任何疑虑……
story.en: Any doubts about the manager's decisions—

story.zh: 我去过。
story.en: I have been to such a club.

story.zh: 特别，频繁。
story.en: Quite often.

story.zh: 不是玩笑。难以理解你们为何这么想。
story.en: I am not. I fail to see why that is difficult for you to accept.

story.zh: 这仅是我四处寻找人生乐趣时探访过的场所之一。
story.en: It was merely one of the places I visited when I used to wander in search of life's joys.

story.zh: 粗略观察该会所的流程，看上去其为私人性质。访客在进入私人会所之前，必须得到站在入口处的门卫的许可。
story.en: A cursory observation of their procedures reveals that it is, in fact, a private club. As a general rule, visitors must receive the bouncers' permission prior to entry.

story.zh: 大部分门卫的体格高于平均水平，还配有武器。
story.en: Most bouncers are of above-average mass and are likely to be armed.

story.zh: 要想在这其中平安通过……
story.en: Key elements to getting past the bouncers are...

story.zh: 听说你是二把手。
story.en: We were last informed that you were the second-in-command.

story.zh: 我们想见你的老大。他在哪里。
story.en: We seek your superior. Tell us of their whereabouts.

story.zh: 明白。你肯定有我们想要的信息。
story.en: Understood. So you must have the information we seek.

story.zh: 我们正在寻找贵帮派所关押的一名人质的下落。交出有关信息。
story.en: We are in search of a certain individual held hostage by this establishment. Hand over the information regarding his whereabouts.

story.zh: 没什么需要特别注意的，经理。他们只是坚信自己局势上始终占优罢了。
story.en: It is nothing of note, manager. It is but a byproduct of their firm belief in their advantage over us.

story.zh: 更值得注意的是，他们在船体下方嵌入了无数锋利的钉子。
story.en: I have observed an oddity, however. They had installed numerous spikes on the lower side of their ship's hull.

story.zh: 它们集中的区域太低，没法用来撞击另一艘船。根据金属腐蚀的程度来看，这些钉子集中在船的龙骨附近，安装的时间并不久。
story.en: They were installed far too low in the water to be useful as a means of ramming another ship. It can be extrapolated from the metal's level of corrosion that the spikes, concentrated on the keel of the boat, have been installed recently.

story.zh: 靠近后水面更加清澈，所以能看见。
story.en: The water was clearer up close than it appeared from a distance.

story.zh: 看来就在不久前，此处还在举行派对。
story.en: It appears that this party must have ended very recently and abruptly.

story.zh: 另外的可能性是，他们在船上的仓库里。
story.en: There is one remaining possibility: the ship's storage space.

story.zh: 观测到处于白色物质之间的脑叶公司徽标。
story.en: I observe the Lobotomy Corp. logo between the white materials.

story.zh: 在D公司那时，我们之中有一个叛徒。因此并不适合用来和现况作比较。
story.en: At D Corp., there was a traitor in our midst. Thus, it would be false equivalency to use that experience to gauge the intensity of this mission.

story.zh: 他的身躯牢牢嵌入了墙壁。常人之力难以将其分离。
story.en: The body is firmly lodged in the walls. No ordinary human strength could separate his body from it.

story.zh: 若是有超人之力，必定会将其身躯一同破坏。
story.en: With superhuman strength, you risk tearing the body to several parts.

story.zh: 并无此类迹象。她的眼神一如既往。
story.en: No such signs have been detected. There is nothing out of the ordinary in her eyes.

story.zh: 她的情绪现在很激动。
story.en: She is experiencing heightened emotions.

story.zh: 由此可以推断，因为他的影响，人鱼们才不敢轻举妄动。
story.en: It can be deduced that it was his influence that kept the Mermaids at bay.

story.zh: 看来留在支部内的人，除我们外都被污染了。
story.en: All organic matter other than us in this Lobotomy Corp. Branch have doubtless been infected.

story.zh: 我们无能为力。
story.en: A fate we can do nothing about.

story.zh: 透过雾气，我观察到数艘船舶的轮廓。然而，它们中没有一艘与梅菲斯托费勒斯相似。
story.en: I observe multiple ships on the horizon, beyond the wall of mist. None of their silhouettes resemble Mephistopheles.

story.zh: 他们向我们发射了什么东西。
story.en: They have launched something in our direction.

story.zh: 唯一的好消息是……
story.en: There is one good news, however...

story.zh: 即便你将拿走的优惠券归还，得到原谅的可能性也极其低下。可以视作为零。
story.en: The chance of your absolution, even if you were to return the coupons, is infinitesimal. Infinitely close to nil, in fact.

story.zh: 因此，那张优惠券可以当作是你的东西了，希斯克利夫。
story.en: Thus, keeping the coupons will make no difference to the outcome of this encounter, Heathcliff. They are now yours.

story.zh: 但，不幸的消息是……
story.en: The bad news...

story.zh: 那边的天气相当糟糕。
story.en: The weather there is quite hostile.

story.zh: 建议靠近观察。我会站起来，用光源来提高我们的能见度。
story.en: A close approach is recommended. I have a source of light to improve our visibility.
Hm...

story.zh: 如果是以贩卖人口为目的的帮派，那么总会留下一两条蛛丝马迹。
story.en: It is a statistical impossibility for a human trafficking Syndicate to leave zero evidence behind. There is bound to be one or two they let slip between their fingers.

story.zh: 特别是当运作规模大到能给街道带来如此大的变化时。那么应该至少也会发现一两具尸体才对。
story.en: Especially if this 'Syndicate' is so prolific to the point of indirectly discouraging the public from leaving their homes, a body or two will invariably be found.

story.zh: 不必感到难过。这个世界上存在着各种癖好的人。
story.en: The manager has no need for your sympathy. I am certain that there are those who appreciate their unique appearance.

story.zh: 有些地方以大门的大小展示身份地位。以这种程度的大小来看……其为相当富裕的豪门。
story.en: It is known that, in certain regions of the City, the size of the front gate is an indicator of one's social standing. The magnitude of this front gate indicates that... the owner of this home is very affluent.

story.zh: 嗯。是鸟类。准确而言是麻雀的亚种。
story.en: A bird. A subspecies of sparrows, to be exact.

story.zh: 根据对友人定义范围的认知差异，答案也会有所不同。
story.en: The answer to that question hinges on the range of affinity one would define as a delineation that separates friends from acquaintances.

story.zh: 这座宅邸平日里似乎并不热闹。
story.en: This manor does not appear to have been a place where liveliness is an expected element.

story.zh: 打扫得十分匆忙，看来仅仅是为了迎接客人。墙面有多处裂痕，能确认到需要修补的部分。
story.en: I see signs of rushed cleaning, conducted immediately before the guests arrived. Several cracks and areas in need of repair have been identified as well.

story.zh: 另外……
story.en: Also…

story.zh: 希斯克利夫。
story.en: Heathcliff.

story.zh: 我已能够推理出构成这等氛围的背景事件。
story.en: I may have a correct assumption as to what this silence indicates.

story.zh: 所以依照惯例，只能向你表达遗憾。
story.en: So I have no other choice but to tell you, as it is common courtesy to do so, that I am very sorry to hear that.

story.zh: 他的呼吸还正常。她准确击打了后脑勺的血管，让他暂且失去了意识。
story.en: His breathing is stable. It appears that she gave the nerve on the back of his head a precise, focused strike, which led to his loss of consciousness.

story.zh: 嗯。一扇玻璃窗毫无征兆地被打碎了。
story.en: Hm. A window shattered, quite literally, out of nowhere.

story.zh: 我判断此处既不是脑叶公司支部，也不像是辛克莱的宅邸中那种与支部相连的通道。
story.en: However, this place does not appear to be the Lobotomy Corp. branch, nor does it appear to be connected to one as Sinclair's mansion was.

story.zh: 知其然而不知其所以然。
story.en: Causeless effects. I fail to see why this is happening.

story.zh: ……了解。
story.en: ... Understood.

story.zh: ……他们穿着各异，年龄和性别也是千差万别。
story.en: ... They are all dressed in different garbs. I don't see any recognizable age or gender patterns among them.

story.zh: 同时我们也曾得知，T公司正在发生大规模的人口失踪案件。
story.en: Recall that large-scale cases of missing persons have been sweeping T Corp. lately.

story.zh: 也就是说……
story.en: Then...

story.zh: 嗯。可以看见两支头朝下的操作杆。
story.en: Mm. I see two levers, both pointed downward.

story.zh: 不可能。我试着靠近他，但感到被一股同等的力量推了回来。
story.en: It is impossible. I am attempting to approach him, yet I feel an equal force pushing me in the opposite direction.

story.zh: 动机不明。但，棺材上的操作杆增加了一个。
story.en: His motives are unknown. But I see that an additional lever has attached itself to the coffin.

story.zh: 停电之后的那刻。
story.en: Immediately after the power outage.

story.zh: 至今为止闪电共落下四次。
story.en: There have been a total of four separate instances of lightning strikes.

story.zh: 如果从公司的立场做出最合理的判断……
story.en: The most logical course of action, from the perspective of our company...

story.zh: 照林顿说的只拿走金枝是正确的。
story.en: ... would have been to wait until the Golden Bough becomes available to us. Just as Linton had suggested earlier.

story.zh: 不。我还没说完，希斯克利夫。感觉以后我有必要练习更快地说话了。
story.en: ... Allow me to finish, Heathcliff. I am beginning to feel the need to practice hastening my speech.

story.zh: 单纯是在此宅邸中行动，风险就在持续增加。希斯克利夫的人身安全能否得到持续保障也值得怀疑。
story.en: We have experienced consistent escalation of risk merely by moving about the manor. Moreover, it is growing increasingly difficult to ensure Heathcliff's safety.

story.zh: 所以我最终……
story.en: Therefore, in conclusion...

story.zh: 判断有必要阻止闪电落下。
story.en: ... I judged that we may have to stop the lightning from striking.

story.zh: 即便这会导致无法获得金枝。
story.en: Even if that decision leads to our failure to obtain the Golden Bough.

story.zh: 我思考了他们是如何绑架如此多的人而至今没有被发现的。
story.en: I have given some thought as to how so many people could disappear without leaving a shred of evidence.

story.zh: 若是单纯由几个黑帮施行绑架，周围却没有抵抗的痕迹。
story.en: It cannot be said that gangs kidnapped them by force, for there were no signs of resistance.

story.zh: 有些则是一家人同时失踪，像这样多人同时被绑架的情况也多次发生。
story.en: There have also been cases of simultaneous disappearances. Sometimes, even entire families would disappear all at once.

story.zh: 那么……与其说强制绑走，说他们是自行前来的反而更合理。
story.en: Then, it can be reasoned that they weren't taken against their will. It would be more believable to say that they followed their would-be kidnappers willingly.

story.zh: 如果没有主治医生采取适当的治疗措施，那个人大概会很快死去。他现处于极度衰弱的状态。
story.en: This man will die without immediate and appropriate medical attention from a professional doctor. He is extremely weakened.

story.zh: 他们……又涌过来了。
story.en: There's... more of them.

story.zh: 数量多于先前。
story.en: They number greater than the last.

story.zh: 推测为存在帮助林顿与凯瑟琳的第三方势力。
story.en: It is possible that there may have been an involvement of a third party that helped Linton and Catherine.

story.zh: 这一定是一个和凯瑟琳很亲近，心理上她也很依赖的人。
story.en: It must be someone close to Catherine. Someone who she heavily relied on.

story.zh: 目标已捕获。这锁链无法维持太久，需要尽早使目标丧失行动能力。
story.en: He is bound. I cannot hold him with these chains for much longer; neutralize the target as soon as possible.

story.zh: 准确地说也包括肩胛骨部位。
story.en: A more accurate recounting of the event would have included the fact that my scapula was also forcibly separated from my torso.

story.zh: 亦可能为某物。情报过于稀少。甚至无法判断目标是否为生物。
story.en: "The thing—or someone" is too insufficient a description. We do not even know if what we seek is made of organic or inorganic material.

story.zh: 我们并未被通知此任务与血魔有所关联。
story.en: We were not informed of any Bloodfiend involvement in this contract.

story.zh: 有某种节目主持人的感觉。最近，都市中部分地区似乎流行起了一种通过摄像机进行简单直播的文化。
story.en: It appears that he is the host of a certain show. It has been reported that, in certain parts of the City, a new culture of "livestreaming" via those cameras has been on the rise.

story.zh: 刚刚开始我们就一直在面向彼此。我没有移开视线的理由。
story.en: We have been looking at each other for a while. There is no reason for me to avert my eyes.

story.zh: 早在十分钟前就已观测到呼吸次数的异常增长。但因尚不影响生理健康，故未报告。
story.en: The gradual acceleration of her breathing patterns was first observed ten minutes ago. I did not report it, as it posed no real risk to her health and well-being.

story.zh: 根据目前为止的经验，制止她是不可能的。
story.en: It can be determined from prior experience that it will be impossible to stop the presently developing situation.

story.zh: 瞳孔扩张，眉间紧锁，不论采用何种话术都大概率无法起到作用。
story.en: Pupils, dilated. Brows, furrowed at a steep angle. Clear refusal to heed any external input. Our attempts to coax her will not be met with any meaningful response.

story.zh: 往往，也就是说，也会存在并非如此的情况。
story.en: You started your sentence with the conditional 'it is often the case'. Therefore, it can be interpreted as a statement that there are cases in which such is not the case.

story.zh: 目视到难以独自穿上的服装。
story.en: I have identified several individuals dressed in clothes that are difficult to be worn without assistance.

story.zh: 是凝固的血。但说是性质相同也没有问题。
story.en: Coagulated blood. Identical to his weapon in essence.

story.zh: 有关血魔和血袋的情报并没有流传太广。
story.en: Consider that information regarding Bloodfiends and Bloodbags is rare to come by for the public.

story.zh: 如果让尚不习惯与其战斗的人于此进行在时限内尽可能排除更多血袋的竞技，取得第一名可能较为困难。
story.en: Had someone unfamiliar with the particulars of battling Bloodbags participated in this competition, it may have been difficult to place first in the leaderboard.

story.zh: 没法立刻从这出戏剧的流向中脱身。
story.en: There is no observable method by which we may escape the flow of this stageplay.

story.zh: 由于是可供儿童游玩的游乐设施，所以不会配有真正的幽灵。只会设置造成恐惧的装置。
story.en: As attractions of that category often admit guests of all ages, including children, they do not place real paranatural entities such as ghosts inside them. However, they often install various tools and visual effects to stimulate fear responses in their guests.

story.zh: 从被撕裂的形状来看，可以认为被挂在这里时就已经被刻意撕裂开。
story.en: It can be extrapolated from the torn patterns that it was intended to be displayed in its current, tattered, form.

story.zh: 观察到附近所有建筑都进行了移动。没有例外。
story.en: Movement has been observed from every building in the vicinity. Everything is changing.

story.zh: 这种无力感会影响作业效率。
story.en: Such sense of futility and powerlessness will negatively impact the efficient performance of your professional obligations.

story.zh: 建议你重复经历以习惯这种感觉。
story.en: Repeated exposure to similar stimuli is recommended to desensitize oneself to this sensation.

story.zh: 气氛变了。
story.en: Things have changed.

story.zh: 这一方与那一方。我们与并非我们的他人。
story.en: Us versus them. In-group versus out-group.

story.zh: 嗯，为了获取无法从书中学到的各种经验，并熟悉外界的文化。
story.en: Mm. The purpose is to learn the varied experiences that cannot be gained from books, to grow familiar with the world outside.

story.zh: 即便是他们慈祥的样子，也和普通家庭中疼爱孩子的表现有些不一样之处。
story.en: The appearance of that 'care' for one's own child was also quite distinct and unusual compared to the typical display of emotional intimacy expressed in average households.

story.zh: 这也不是我们第一次在如此荒谬的情况下执行任务了。
story.en: This is not the first instance in which we are demanded to work through a task in an unfavorable, inequitable situation.

story.zh: 嗯。不过也算是有意义的准备运动了。
story.en: Mm. Nevertheless, this was a meaningful warm-up activity.

story.zh: 既然有行动指南和预期目标，那它就符合“计划”的定义。
story.en: It matches the definition of a ‘plan,’ given that it illustrates certain instructions to be followed for the purpose of achieving a defined goal.

story.zh: 是E.G.O装备。
story.en: E.G.O gears.

story.zh: 可推测为比我们曾经遭遇的里卡多更强且更具威胁的强者。
story.en: ... Is more powerful and violent than Ricardo, an individual we had encountered in the past.

story.zh: 大部分人在困惑中将嘴张大至一定程度以上，或是带着满脸愤怒与忧虑大叫。
story.en: A large portion of the audience is vociferously expressing their collective confusion, wrath, and concern. These emotions are expressed by their jaws that have been opened past a certain degree.

story.zh: “成为第二名，拿到金枝”，这不会变。
story.en: Contextual clues suggest that the 'one purpose' is implied to be 'come in second place and obtain the Golden Bough'.

story.zh: 如果我们在讨论的是一场已经进展到了某种程度的战争的话，那么奥提斯的评估是正确的。
story.en: Outis's assessment would have been correct had the discussion concerning our participation been about a war that has already progressed beyond a certain degree.

story.zh: 但是如果能在战争初期将其镇压的话，则能够获得比避战更大的收益。
story.en: However, accepting Jia Qiu's suggestion and preventing the war from expanding beyond localized skirmishes could bring greater benefits than avoiding it altogether.

story.zh: 按原定计划，雷横目前应该在大观园入口处与贾丘对峙。
story.en: Our plan was to leave the matter of Lei Heng for Jia Qiu to deal with at the battlefield by the front gate of Daguanyuan.

story.zh: 迄今为止的营养供应也是由家主来负责的。他们的生命会慢慢耗尽吧。
story.en: It is likely that the sole nutrient supplier for them was the Family Hierarch. Their deaths will be very slow.

story.zh: 我已理解你的目的，但决定权在经理手中。
story.en: Your intent has been understood, but it is up to the manager to command me.

story.zh: 了解。
story.en: Then it will be done.

story.zh: 可能是由于被分配了因违反合同而导致的额外工作所导致，但即便考虑到这一点，缺席的持续时间仍不寻常。
story.en: The breach of contract may have led to extra workload for him, but even so, his prolonged absence remains unusual.

story.zh: 已经注意到了三具身份不明的尸体，但从身高和服装因素考虑……是霍恩海姆的可能性非常低。
story.en: I have identified three bodies in various states that make immediate recognition challenging. However, their stature and attire make it extremely unlikely that any of them are Hohenheim.

story.zh: 在32具尸体中，有26具拥有相同的伤口。
story.en: Out of 32 bodies, 26 show identical physical trauma.

story.zh: 共同点在于胸部中央，心脏所在位置有螺旋状的贯通伤。推测凶器为握在尸体手中的螺旋状物体，执行经理。
story.en: Every one of them has a spiral-shaped perforation at the center of the chest, over where the heart is. Their cause of death seems to be the same type of "spiral" weapon they are holding in their hands, Manager.

story.zh: ……嗯。听见了。
story.en: ... Mm. I hear it.

story.zh: 就在这附近。
story.en: In this general direction.

story.zh: 很低。呼吸紊乱且微弱，接近于负伤的人类。
story.en: Unlikely. The breathing is unstable and shallow, like that of a wounded human.

story.zh: 左手边通往福利部的通道被封锁了，而右手边通往控制室的通道则是被瓦砾堵住了。
story.en: The corridor to the left leading to the Welfare Department was closed off, and the one to the right, leading to the Facility Management Room, was blocked with debris.

story.zh: 可以认为除了前往广播部门以外的路线全都堵塞了。
story.en: All the other routes were blocked off save for the one leading to this sector.

story.zh: 预防异想体出逃而设置的隔离系统似乎已经被启动了。
story.en: It would seem that a quarantine system designed for Abnormality containment breaches has just been activated.

story.zh: 嗯。
story.en: Mm.

story.zh: 我曾有过抽烟的时期。只是找不到持续下去的理由。
story.en: There was a time when I partook. But I could not find any reason to maintain the habit.

story.zh: 几乎所有被称为“烟”的东西。
story.en: Most things that fall under the category of "cigarette."

story.zh: 如果有必要，我会去做通常被认为是正确的事，也会去做被认为是不正确的事。
story.en: I partook in both categories of activities—those generally accepted as right, and those accepted as wrong.

story.zh: 正前方。电梯正在运作。
story.en: The elevator up ahead is operational.

story.zh: 你指的是这个人吗。他虽然有意装死，但脉搏还在。
story.en: You must be referring to this man. He's pretending to be dead, but his pulse hasn't stopped.

story.zh: 是在迷宫与折射轨道频繁目击到的实体。执行经理。
story.en: It is the same entity we repeatedly encountered during our passages through Dungeons and Refraction Railways, Manager.

story.zh: 明白了，经理。
story.en: Understood, Manager.

story.zh: 你的同伴们，以这条走廊为基准，位于东南方向。
story.en: Your colleagues are located to the southeast of this corridor.

story.zh: 考虑到出发时间，大约相距2km。
story.en: Considering the time of their departure, they should be approximately 2 kilometers away.

story.zh: 是。
story.en: We have.

story.zh: 他不会继续协助我们。经理。
story.en: He would not have cooperated further, Manager.

story.zh: 他的时间观念很严格。
story.en: That man has an uncompromising sense of punctuality.

story.zh: 我确实认识此人，但并未达到世人常说的“相识”那种程度。
story.en: It is true that I am acquainted with him, but not in the scope of familiarity that society typically attributes to the word.

story.zh: 没有。他曾是N公司的禁忌猎人。
story.en: No. He used to be a Taboo Hunter at N Corp.

story.zh: 是。
story.en: I did.

story.zh: 不是。
story.en: I was not.

story.zh: 我只是有机会浏览他的档案。
story.en: I had merely come upon an opportunity to examine his file,

story.zh: 并按文件漫步于可能与他相遇的地点，最终与他相遇了而已。
story.en: and frequented the places the examination suggested a high chance of encountering him until our paths crossed.

story.zh: ……嗯。我没有不这么做的理由。经理。
story.en: ... Mm. There was no reason not to, Manager.

story.zh: 没有回答。这是……
story.en: No response. This is...

story.zh: 虽然我们此前通过无声的默契将执行经理和新来的研究员从袭击者那里隔开，但刚才这场突袭对我们而言并没有简单到能同时保护两人。
story.en: Our mutual, tacit recognition of the threat allowed us to quickly distance the manager and the new hire away from the assailant. However, the circumstances of the attack forced us to choose one over the other.

story.zh: 由于经理这次也没能记住当时的情况，我会对事件进行说明。
story.en: I will explain the sequence of events, as it is clear that the manager once again remembers none of it.

story.zh: 大约七分钟前，经理头部的火焰同之前一样开始剧烈燃烧，随后原先不在场的罪人以类似被召唤或生成的方式出现了。
story.en: Approximately 7 minutes prior, the flame on your head began to conflagrate as it did in the previously observed instance, before the absent Sinners were, for lack of a better descriptor, "summoned" or "materialized" here.

story.zh: 按照作战计划，我们要在这里原地待命直到LCA抵达，随后才能去找回金枝。
story.en: The plan dictates that we are to hold this position until the LCA arrives, then mobilize to secure the Golden Bough.

story.zh: 还需要再往后退一些，经理。基于其假面和衣着，此人正是简报中所提及的食指父辈。
story.en: You must withdraw further to the back, Manager. This individual's mask and outfit suggest that he is the Nursefather of the Index mentioned during the briefing.

story.zh: 虽然罕有生活痕迹，但可以确认到定期打扫的迹象。
story.en: While the signs of habitation are minimal, there is evidence of regular cleaning.

story.zh: 并不是遗失。只是前来取回被夺走的东西。
story.en: Nothing was lost. We are here to retrieve what's stolen from us.

story.zh: 没有问题。只需听从经理的命令。
story.en: There shouldn't be any issues. I merely follow the manager's orders.

story.zh: 如果存在仅凭斩击便能切去概念的事物……想必没有比那更为便利的技术了吧。
story.en: If concepts can be destroyed with a simple slash of the sword... it would indeed be a technology of an unprecedented convenience.

story.zh: 嗯……能确认到那人在断气前抓住经理脚踝的行为，而经理也一样并未发出滴答声……
story.en: Mm... I saw her clinging weakly to the Manager's ankle in a near-death state. The Manager did not make a single ticking sound, and...

story.zh: 嗯。
story.en: Mm.

story.zh: ……被斩断的只是和经理的契约，和边狱公司的合同条款并未失去效力。
story.en: ... What is broken is only the pact forged with the Manager. The clauses of her contract with Limbus Company remain in effect.
